method:
Verify the partial mechanics profile and inventory config declarations as JSON.

This is a source inventory, not a C preprocessor or runtime behavior test.
Conditional declarations are retained individually; comments are upstream evidence,
not independently verified claims about the retail games.

definitions.name: STAY_IN_STATS_RAISED
definitions.upstream_comment: Number of stat stages that must be raised across any stats before the AI won't switch mon out in certain cases

definitions.name: STAY_IN_ABSORBING_PERCENTAGE
definitions.upstream_comment: Chance to stay in if outgoing mon has super effective move against player, will prevent switching out for an absorber with this likelihood

definitions.name: SHOULD_SWITCH_CHOICE_LOCKED_PERCENTAGE
definitions.upstream_comment: Only if locked into status move

definitions.name: SHOULD_SWITCH_DYN_FUNC_PERCENTAGE
definitions.upstream_comment: Dynamic switching function switch chance

definitions.name: SHOULD_SWITCH_LOSES_1V1_PERCENTAGE
definitions.upstream_comment: Keeping this disabled by default makes evaluating and testing switching behaviour when developing much easier

definitions.name: ALL_MOVES_BAD_STATUS_MOVES_BAD
definitions.upstream_comment: If the AI has no moves that affect the target, ShouldSwitchIfAllMovesBad can prompt a switch. Enabling this config will ignore status moves that can affect the target when making this decision.

definitions.name: AI_BAD_SCORE_THRESHOLD
definitions.upstream_comment: Move scores beneath this threshold are considered "bad" when deciding switching

definitions.name: AI_GOOD_SCORE_THRESHOLD
definitions.upstream_comment: Move scores above this threshold are considered "good" when deciding switching

definitions.name: ALL_MOVES_BAD_NEEDS_GOOD_SWITCHIN
definitions.upstream_comment: AI will only trigger ShouldSwitchIfAllMovesBad if they have a good switchin

definitions.name: ALL_SCORES_BAD_NEEDS_GOOD_SWITCHIN
definitions.upstream_comment: AI will only trigger ShouldSwitchIfAllScoresBad if they have a good switchin

definitions.name: AI_DEFENSIVE_KO_THRESHOLD
definitions.upstream_comment: AI must be able to take more than this many hits before being KO'd before being considered a "defensive mon"

definitions.name: AI_TYPE_MATCHUP_THRESHOLD
definitions.upstream_comment: AI must have a better matchup than this to be considered good; 2.0 is the default "Neutral" matchup from GetBattlerTypeMatchup

definitions.name: AI_WISH_HEAL_THRESHOLD
definitions.upstream_comment: Fraction of HP AI must restore to be considered a good recipient of Wish, treated as a fraction denominator (ie. 4 = 1/4 = 25% HP)

definitions.name: AI_SWITCHIN_DAMAGE_THRESHOLD
definitions.upstream_comment: Damage AI must exceed to be considered an acceptable switchin candidate. Keep this *very low*, as it's used as a fallback case before giving up.

definitions.name: AI_REVERSE_BATTLER_LOGIC_ORDER_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: Chance to reverse the order of mons when running AI logic in double battles. For example if both mons want to switch and there's only one mon to switch in, the first mon processed will get to switch; setting this above zero controls the chance of switching which slot is processed first

definitions.name: LOW_ACCURACY_THRESHOLD
definitions.upstream_comment: Moves with accuracy equal OR below this value are considered low accuracy

definitions.name: STATUS_MOVE_FOCUS_PUNCH_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: Chance the AI will use a status move if the player's best move is Focus Punch

definitions.name: BOOST_INTO_HAZE_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: Chance the AI will use a stat boosting move if the player has used Haze

definitions.name: SHOULD_RECOVER_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: Chance the AI will give recovery moves score increase if less than ENABLE_RECOVERY_THRESHOLD and in no immediate danger

definitions.name: ENABLE_RECOVERY_THRESHOLD
definitions.upstream_comment: HP percentage beneath which SHOULD_RECOVER_CHANCE is active

definitions.name: SUCKER_PUNCH_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: Chance for the AI to not use Sucker Punch if the player has a status move

definitions.name: SUCKER_PUNCH_PREDICTION_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: Additional chance for the AI to not use Sucker Punch if actively predicting a status move if SUCKER_PUNCH_CHANCE fails

definitions.name: PRIORITIZE_LAST_CHANCE_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: Chance the AI will prioritize Last Chance (priority move in the face of being outsped and KO'd) over Slow KO

definitions.name: LAST_MON_PREFERS_NOT_SACRIFICE
definitions.upstream_comment: Whether the AI will be hesitant to use self-sacrificing moves (Explosion, Final Gambit) with their last mon

definitions.name: EXPLOSION_LOWER_HP_THRESHOLD
definitions.upstream_comment: HP percentage at or beneath which the AI has a 90% chance to explode; otherwise scales between this and higher threshold

definitions.name: EXPLOSION_HIGHER_HP_THRESHOLD
definitions.upstream_comment: HP percentage at or above which the AI has a 0% chance to explode; otherwise scales between this and lower threshold

definitions.name: EXPLOSION_MINIMUM_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: Lowest possible percent chance of the AI using explosion based on its current HP

definitions.name: EXPLOSION_MAXIMUM_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: Highest possible percent chance of the AI using explosion based on its current HP

definitions.name: FINAL_GAMBIT_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: Chance for AI to consider using Final Gambit if it outspeeds the player and thinks it has more HP

definitions.name: SHOULD_PIVOT_BREAK_SASH_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: Chance for ShouldPivot to return true when trying to break Multiscale and Focus Sash type effects while having a good switchin

definitions.name: FAKE_OUT_SAVE_ALLY_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: Chance for AI to Fake Out to save its ally when ally is fast KO'd by both opponents

definitions.name: RISKY_AI_CRIT_STAGE_THRESHOLD
definitions.upstream_comment: Stat stages at which Risky will assume it gets a crit

definitions.name: RISKY_AI_CRIT_THRESHOLD_GEN_1
definitions.upstream_comment: "Stat stage" at which Risky will assume it gets a crit with gen 1 mechanics (this translates to an X / 255 % crit threshold)

definitions.name: AI_DAMAGES_THROUGH_BERRIES
definitions.upstream_comment: AI will see through resist berries when considering a certain KO threshold for the purposes damage calcs; this is considered when comparing best moves to KO to still pick the actual OHKO if needed

definitions.name: AI_IGNORE_BERRY_KO_THRESHOLD
definitions.upstream_comment: KO threshold AI must meet in order to treat it berry though it doesn't exist (ie. 2 means "If the AI can 2HKO with berry resisted attack + not-berry resisted next attack, ignore berry resistence when calcing first attack"). Requires AI_DAMAGES_THROUGH_BERRIES

definitions.name: AI_CONSERVE_TERA_CHANCE_PER_MON
definitions.upstream_comment: Chance for AI with smart tera flag to decide not to tera before considering defensive benefit is this*(X-1), where X is the number of alive Pokémon that could tera

definitions.name: AI_TERA_PREDICT_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: Chance for AI with smart tera flag to tera in the situation where tera would save it from a KO, but could be punished by a KO from a different move.

definitions.name: PP_STALL_DISREGARD_MOVE_PERCENTAGE
definitions.upstream_comment: Detection chance per roll

definitions.name: PP_STALL_SCORE_REDUCTION
definitions.upstream_comment: Score reduction if any roll for PP stall detection passes

definitions.name: ASSUME_STAB_SEES_ABILITY
definitions.upstream_comment: Flag also gives omniscience for player's ability. Can use AI_FLAG_WEIGH_ABILITY_PREDICTION instead for smarter prediction without omniscience.

definitions.name: ASSUME_STATUS_MOVES_HAS_TUNING
definitions.upstream_comment: Flag has varying rates for different kinds of status move.

definitions.name: ASSUME_STATUS_HIGH_ODDS
definitions.upstream_comment: Chance for AI to see extremely likely moves for a Pokémon to have, like Spore

definitions.name: ASSUME_STATUS_MEDIUM_ODDS
definitions.upstream_comment: Chance for AI to see moderately likely moves for a Pokémon to have, like Protect

definitions.name: ASSUME_STATUS_LOW_ODDS
definitions.upstream_comment: Chance for AI to see niche moves a Pokémon may have but probably won't, like Entrainment

definitions.name: ASSUME_ALL_STATUS_ODDS
definitions.upstream_comment: Chance for the AI to see any kind of status move.

definitions.name: SMART_SWITCHING_OMNISCIENT
definitions.upstream_comment: AI will use omniscience for switching calcs, regardless of omniscience setting otherwise

definitions.name: RANDOMIZE_SWITCHIN_ANY_VALID
definitions.upstream_comment: If AI has no good candidate mons, it will still choose randomly from all valid options rather than defaulting to the last one in party order

definitions.name: FRIENDLY_FIRE_RISKY_THRESHOLD
definitions.upstream_comment: AI_FLAG_RISKY acceptable number of hits to KO the partner via friendly fire

definitions.name: FRIENDLY_FIRE_NORMAL_THRESHOLD
definitions.upstream_comment: typical acceptable number of hits to KO the partner via friendly fire

definitions.name: FRIENDLY_FIRE_CONSERVATIVE_THRESHOLD
definitions.upstream_comment: AI_FLAG_CONSERVATIVE acceptable number of hits to KO the partner via friendly fire

definitions.name: DOUBLE_TRICK_ROOM_ON_LAST_TURN_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: both Pokémon use Trick Room on turn Trick Room expires in the hopes both opponents used Protect to stall, getting a free refresh on the timer

definitions.name: TAILWIND_IN_TRICK_ROOM_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: use Tailwind on turn Trick Room expires in the hopes both opponents used Protect to stall

definitions.name: AI_FLAG_ATTACKS_PARTNER_FOCUSES_PARTNER
definitions.upstream_comment: if TRUE, AI_FLAG_ATTACKS_PARTNER prefers attacking the partner over the ally.

definitions.name: Z_EFFECT_RESTORE_HP_LOWER_THRESHOLD
definitions.upstream_comment: threshold used for moves you could conceivably use more than once

definitions.name: Z_EFFECT_RESTORE_HP_HIGHER_THRESHOLD
definitions.upstream_comment: these moves are one-time use or drop your HP

definitions.name: B_CRIT_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: Chances of landing a critical hit. See CalcCritChanceStage. Gen6+ chances guarantee a crit at 3 or more stages. Gen1 chances are based on half of the user's base Speed.

definitions.name: B_CRIT_MULTIPLIER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, critical hits increase damage by 1.5x instead of 2x.

definitions.name: B_PARALYSIS_SPEED
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, paralysis decreases Speed by 50% instead of 75%.

definitions.name: B_CONFUSION_SELF_DMG_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, a Pokémon will hurt itself in confusion 1/3 of the time instead of half.

definitions.name: B_MULTI_HIT_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, multistrike moves have different chances for the number of times they hit. See SetRandomMultiHitCounter for values.

definitions.name: B_WHITEOUT_MONEY
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, the amount of money dropped after losing a battle is determined by the number of Badges obtained. Previously, half of the player's money would be dropped. (While this change was also in FRLG, for the sake of simplicity, setting this to GEN_3 will result in RSE behavior.)

definitions.name: B_LIGHT_BALL_ATTACK_BOOST
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, Light Ball doubles Attack in addition to Sp. Atk.

definitions.name: B_PARALYSIS_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Champions, paralysis has a 12.5% chance of not moving, instead of 25%.

definitions.name: B_EXP_CATCH
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, the party gains experience when the player catches another Pokémon.

definitions.name: B_TRAINER_EXP_MULTIPLIER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, Trainer battles no longer increase total experience by 1.5x.

definitions.name: B_SPLIT_EXP
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, all Pokémon that participate in a battle gain full experience. In Gen5 and earlier, the total experience would be evenly split across them.

definitions.name: B_SCALED_EXP
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5 and Gen7+, experience gain is weighted by the difference between the levels of the player's Pokémon and the target.

definitions.name: B_UNEVOLVED_EXP_MULTIPLIER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, if a Pokémon is at or past the level where it would be able to evolve, but it has not, it gains ~1.2x experience. This only applies to species with the EVO_LEVEL method.

definitions.name: B_LEVEL_UP_NOTIFICATION
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, if a Pokémon gains enough experience to level up multiple times, a message is only displayed once.

definitions.name: B_BADGE_BOOST
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, Gym Badges no longer boost a Pokémon's stats. (Setting this to GEN_2 does not include the additional boost to the type matching the Gym the Badge is from.)

definitions.name: B_FRIENDSHIP_BOOST
definitions.upstream_comment: In LGPE only, all stats except HP are boosted by up to 10% depending on on friendship. Unlike B_BADGE_BOOST, these boosts are accounted for when calculating base stats.

definitions.name: B_MAX_LEVEL_EV_GAINS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, level 100 Pokémon can obtain Effort Values from battles.

definitions.name: B_RECALCULATE_STATS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, the stats of Pokémon that participate in battle are recalculated at the end of battle, rather than upon level up or being deposited in the PC.

definitions.name: B_BURN_DAMAGE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen1 and Gen7+, burn damage is 1/16 of max HP instead of 1/8. This also applies to Frostbite.

definitions.name: B_BURN_FACADE_DMG
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, burn's Attack halving effect no longer applies to Facade.

definitions.name: B_BINDING_DAMAGE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, binding damage is 1/8 of max HP instead of 1/16. If the user is holding a Binding Band, it is 1/6 instead of 1/8.

definitions.name: B_PSYWAVE_DMG
definitions.upstream_comment: Psywave's damage formula. See DoFixedDamageMoveCalc for details.

definitions.name: B_PAYBACK_SWITCH_BOOST
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Payback's base power no longer doubles if the opponent switches out.

definitions.name: B_HIDDEN_POWER_DMG
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, Hidden Power's base power is 60. Previously, it was determined by the Pokémon's IVs.

definitions.name: B_ROUGH_SKIN_DMG
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, Rough Skin's contact damage is 1/8 of max HP instead of 1/16. This also applies to Iron Barbs.

definitions.name: B_KNOCK_OFF_DMG
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, Knock Off deals 50% more damage if the target is holding an item that can be knocked off.

definitions.name: B_SPORT_DMG_REDUCTION
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Water/Mud Sport reduce Fire-/Electric-type damage by 67% instead of 50%.

definitions.name: B_EXPLOSION_DEFENSE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Self-Destruct and Explosion no longer halve the targets' Defense.

definitions.name: B_PARENTAL_BOND_DMG
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, Parental Bond's second hit does 25% of the initial hit's damage instead of 50%.

definitions.name: B_MULTIPLE_TARGETS_DMG
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, damage dealt by moves that hit multiple targets at once is reduced to 75%. Previously, it was 50%, unless the move hit the entire field, in which case there was no reduction.

definitions.name: B_GHOSTS_ESCAPE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, escape prevention fails on Ghost-types. Additionally, attempting to escape from a wild battle is always sucessful.

definitions.name: B_PARALYZE_ELECTRIC
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, Electric-types can no longer be paralyzed.

definitions.name: B_POWDER_GRASS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, Grass-types are immune to powder and spore moves.

definitions.name: B_UPDATED_TYPE_MATCHUPS
definitions.upstream_comment: Changes type matchups. src/data/types_info.h for details.

definitions.name: B_PRANKSTER_DARK_TYPES
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, Prankster-elevated status moves do not affect Dark-types.

definitions.name: B_SHEER_COLD_IMMUNITY
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, Ice-types are immune to Sheer Cold.

definitions.name: B_ROOST_PURE_FLYING
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Roost turns pure Flying-types into Normal-types.

definitions.name: B_STATUS_TYPE_IMMUNITY
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen1, Pokémon were immune to additional effects of attacking moves if they shared a type with the move.

definitions.name: B_BINDING_TURNS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, binding moves last for 4-5 turns instead of 2-5. If the user is holding a Grip Claw, they last for 7 turns instead of 5.

definitions.name: B_UPROAR_TURNS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Uproar lasts for 3 turns instead of 2-5.

definitions.name: B_UPROAR_IGNORE_SOUNDPROOF
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Uproar's effects ignore Soundproof.

definitions.name: B_DISABLE_TURNS
definitions.upstream_comment: Disable's turns. See Cmd_disablelastusedattack.

definitions.name: B_TAILWIND_TURNS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Tailwind lasts 4 turns instead of 3.

definitions.name: B_SLEEP_TURNS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, sleep prevents movement for 1-3 turns. In Gens3-4, it was 1-4 turns. In Gen2, it was 1-7 turns.

definitions.name: B_TAUNT_TURNS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Taunt lasts 3 turns if the user acts before the target, or 4 turns if the target acted before the user. In Gen4, it lasted 2-4/3-5 turns. In Gen3, it lasted 2/3 turns.

definitions.name: B_ENCORE_TURNS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Encore lasts 3 turns if the target hasn't yet moved this turn, or 4 turns if it has. In Gen4, it lasts 3-7 turns. In Gen2-3, 2-6 turns.

definitions.name: B_SPORT_TURNS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, Water/Mud Sport last 5 turns, even if the user switches out. In Gen5 and earlier, they lasted until the user switched out.

definitions.name: B_MEGA_EVO_TURN_ORDER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7, a Pokémon's Speed after Mega Evolution is used to determine turn order, rather than its previous Speed.

definitions.name: B_RECALC_TURN_AFTER_ACTIONS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, switching or using a move affects the current turn's order of actions, better known as dynamic Speed.

definitions.name: B_FAINT_SWITCH_IN
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, sending out a new Pokémon after the previous one fainted happens at the end of the turn. Previously, it would happen after each action.

definitions.name: B_MEGA_EVO_SPEED_SWAP
definitions.upstream_comment: In Champions, Mega Evolution does not overwrite the speed stat swapped via Speed Swap.

definitions.name: B_FREEZE_TURNS
definitions.upstream_comment: Prior to Champions, freeze has a 20% chance of being thawed out.

definitions.name: B_UPDATED_MOVE_DATA
definitions.upstream_comment: Updates move data in gMovesInfo, including Power, Accuracy, PP, category, range, and additional effects.

definitions.name: B_UPDATED_MOVE_TYPES
definitions.upstream_comment: Updates move types in gMovesInfo.

definitions.name: B_UPDATED_MOVE_FLAGS
definitions.upstream_comment: Updates move flags in gMovesInfo.

definitions.name: B_PHYSICAL_SPECIAL_SPLIT
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gens1-3, a move's type determines if it will do physical or special damage. The category icon in the summary will reflect this.

definitions.name: B_RECOIL_IF_MISS_DMG
definitions.upstream_comment: Crash damage's formula. See EFFECT_RECOIL_IF_MISS.

definitions.name: B_KLUTZ_FLING_INTERACTION
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Pokémon with the Klutz Ability can no longer use Fling.

definitions.name: B_UPDATED_CONVERSION
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, Conversion changes the user's type to match that of their first move. In Gen5 and earlier, it would choose a move at random.

definitions.name: B_UPDATED_CONVERSION_2
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Conversion 2 changes the user's type to a type that resists the last move used by the selected target. In Gen4 and earlier, it would consider the last move the user was successfully hit by. Additionally, Struggle was considered Normal-type.

definitions.name: B_PP_REDUCED_BY_SPITE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, Spite reduces the PP of the target's last move by 4 instead of 2-5.

definitions.name: B_EXTRAPOLATED_MOVE_FLAGS
definitions.upstream_comment: Adds flags to moves that they don't officially have, but would likely have if they were in the latest core series game.

definitions.name: B_HIDDEN_POWER_COUNTER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen3 and earlier, Counter and Mirror Coat treat Hidden Power as physical regardless of type.

definitions.name: B_MODERN_TRICK_CHOICE_LOCK
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, if a choice item is swapped for another choice item, the Trick/Switcheroo user can choose another move before being locked into it.

definitions.name: B_PROTECT_FAILURE_RATE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, protection moves fail 1/3 of the time instead of 1/2.

definitions.name: B_UPDATED_ABILITY_DATA
definitions.upstream_comment: Affects flags.

definitions.name: B_TOXIC_NEVER_MISS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, Toxic bypasses accuracy checks when used by Poison-types.

definitions.name: B_MINIMIZE_DMG_ACC
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, moves that deal double damage to minimized Pokémon will bypass accuracy checks.

definitions.name: B_BLIZZARD_HAIL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, Blizzard bypasses accuracy checks if it's hailing.

definitions.name: B_SHEER_COLD_ACC
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, Sheer Cold's accuracy is reduced to 20% if the user isn't an Ice-type.

definitions.name: B_FELL_STINGER_STAT_RAISE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, if Fell Stinger causes the target to faint, the user's Attack raises by 3 stages instead of 2.

definitions.name: B_KINGS_SHIELD_LOWER_ATK
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, King's Shield lowers the Attack of Pokémon that hit it by 1 stage instead of 2.

definitions.name: B_SPEED_BUFFING_RAPID_SPIN
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, Rapid Spin raises the user's Speed by 1 stage if it hits.

definitions.name: B_CHARGE_SPDEF_RAISE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Charge raises the user's Sp. Def by 1 stage.

definitions.name: B_MINIMIZE_EVASION
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Minimize raises the user's evasion by 2 stages instead of 1.

definitions.name: B_GROWTH_STAT_RAISE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Growth raises the user's Attack in addition to its Sp. Atk. They are each raised by 1 stage normally, and by 2 stages if it's sunny.

definitions.name: B_FOCUS_ENERGY_CRIT_RATIO
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen3+, Focus Energy raises the critical-hit ratio of the user's moves by 2 stages instead of 1.

definitions.name: B_PSYCH_UP_CRIT_RATIO
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, Psych Up also copies the target's critical hit ratio.

definitions.name: B_INCINERATE_GEMS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, Incinerate can destroy Gems.

definitions.name: B_CAN_SPITE_FAIL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, Spite no longer fails if the target's last move has only 1 PP remaining.

definitions.name: B_CRASH_IF_TARGET_IMMUNE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, moves with crash damage will crash if the user attacks a target that is immune due to their typing.

definitions.name: B_MEMENTO_FAIL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, Memento no longer fails if the target already has -6 Attack and Sp. Atk. Additionally, in Gen5+, it fails if there is no target, or if the target is protected or behind a Substitute.

definitions.name: B_PARTING_SHOT_SWITCH
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, the user won't switch out if Parting Shot fails to lower the target's stats.

definitions.name: B_BATON_PASS_TRAPPING
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Baton Pass does not keep trapping effects on other battlers when the user switches out.

definitions.name: B_GLARE_GHOST
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, Glare can hit Ghost-type Pokémon.

definitions.name: B_SKILL_SWAP
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, Skill Swap triggers switch-in Abilities after use.

definitions.name: B_BRICK_BREAK
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, you can destroy your own side's screens. Additionally, in Gen5+, screens are no longer destroyed if the target is immune due to their typing.

definitions.name: B_WISH_HP_SOURCE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Wish heals by half of the user's max HP instead of the recipient's.

definitions.name: B_RAMPAGE_CONFUSION
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Rampage is canceled after the move (as opposed to End Turn) and a failed rampage move will cancel the counter, unless it is the last turn.

definitions.name: B_HEAL_BLOCKING
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Heal Block prevents healing by Black Sludge, Leftovers, and Shell Bell. Affected Pokémon will not consume held HP-restoring Berries or Berry Juice. Abilities will not heal but will prevent damage.

definitions.name: B_ROOTED_GROUNDING
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, Ingrain causes the user to become grounded.

definitions.name: B_METRONOME_MOVES
definitions.upstream_comment: Determines up to and including which generation Metronome will call moves from.

definitions.name: B_TELEPORT_BEHAVIOR
definitions.upstream_comment: In LGPE onwards (Gen8+ here), Teleport switches the user out instead of fleeing.

definitions.name: B_BEAT_UP
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Beat Up uses a different formula to calculate its damage, and deals Dark-type damage. In Gen4 and earlier, each hit announces the party member's name.

definitions.name: B_DARK_VOID_FAIL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, only Darkrai can use Dark Void.

definitions.name: B_HIT_THAW
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, damaging moves that thaw the user will thaw the target. In Gen 3+, Fire-type moves thaw the target. In Gen 1-2, damaging moves that can burn will thaw the target, regardless if they can be burned or not.

definitions.name: B_HEALING_WISH_SWITCH
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, the Pokémon receiving Healing Wish/Lunar Dance is sent out at the end of the turn. Additionally, in Gen8+, the effect will be stored until the user switches into a statused or hurt Pokémon.

definitions.name: B_DEFOG_EFFECT_CLEARING
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Defog does not lower the evasion of a target behind a Subsitute. In Gen6+, Defog also clears hazards from the user's side. In Gen8+, Defog also clears active Terrain.

definitions.name: B_STOCKPILE_RAISES_DEFS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, Stockpile also raises Defense and Sp. Def stats. Once Spit Up/Swallow is used, these stat changes are lost.

definitions.name: B_TRANSFORM_SEMI_INV_FAIL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen2+, Transform fails if the target is semi-invulnerable.

definitions.name: B_TRANSFORM_TARGET_FAIL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen2+, Transform fails if the target is already transformed.

definitions.name: B_TRANSFORM_USER_FAIL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Transform fails if the user is already transformed.

definitions.name: B_TRANSFORM_SUBSTITUTE_FAIL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Transform fails if the target is behind a Substitute.

definitions.name: B_TRANSFORM_SHINY
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, Transform will copy the Shininess of the opponent instead of maintaining its own Shininess.

definitions.name: B_TRANSFORM_BATTLE_REWARDS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen3 and Gen 4, a Transform'ed Pokemon will give the xp and ev yield of its copied species whereas it gives the xp and ev yield of the original species in other gens

definitions.name: B_TRANSFORM_CATCH_RATE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen3 and Geb 4, Transform'ed will have the catch rate of the tranformed species but they will keep their original catch rate in other generations

definitions.name: B_TRANSFORM_FORM_CHANGES
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Transformed Pokémon can no longer change forms.

definitions.name: B_WIDE_GUARD
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5 only, Wide Guard has a chance to fail if used consecutively.

definitions.name: B_QUICK_GUARD
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5 only, Quick Guard has a chance to fail if used consecutively.

definitions.name: B_IMPRISON
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Imprison does not fail if opposing Pokémon don't have any moves the user knows.

definitions.name: B_TAUNT_ME_FIRST
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Taunt does not block Me First.

definitions.name: B_ALLY_SWITCH_FAIL_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, Ally Switch has a chance to fail if used consecutively.

definitions.name: B_SKETCH_BANS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, Sketch is able to copy less moves than in previous generations.

definitions.name: B_KNOCK_OFF_REMOVAL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Knock Off removes the foe's item instead of rendering it unusable.

definitions.name: B_HEAL_BELL_SOUNDPROOF
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, Heal Bell affects inactive party members with Soundproof. In Gen5 only, it affects all party members, including active ones. In Gen4 and earlier, it does not affect any Pokémon with Soundproof.

definitions.name: B_CHARGE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7 and earlier, Charge status is lost regardless of the typing of the next move.

definitions.name: B_POWDER_STATUS_HEAVY_RAIN
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, Powder no longer damages the user of a Fire-type move in heavy rain.

definitions.name: B_AFTER_YOU_TURN_ORDER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, After You no longer fails if the turn order wouldn't change after use.

definitions.name: B_QUASH_TURN_ORDER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, Quash-affected battlers move according to Speed order. In Gen7 and earlier, Quash-affected battlers move in the order they were affected by Quash.

definitions.name: B_DESTINY_BOND_FAIL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, Destiny Bond fails if used repeatedly.

definitions.name: B_FORESIGHT_FAIL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen2 and Gen5+, Foresight fails if used against a target already under its effect.

definitions.name: B_MIRACLE_EYE_FAIL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Miracle Eye fails if used against a target already under its effect.

definitions.name: B_PURSUIT_TARGET
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, Pursuit automatically targets and attacks any switching opponent. Previously, it only attacked a switching opponent if they were chose as the target.

definitions.name: B_SKIP_RECHARGE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen1 only, moves with recharge turns do not need to recharge if they knock out the target.

definitions.name: B_ENCORE_TARGET
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, an encored Pokémon can select the target of its move.

definitions.name: B_TIME_OF_DAY_HEALING_MOVES
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen2 only, the amount of HP restored by Morning Sun, Synthesis, and Moonlight doubles during the morning, day, and night, respectively.

definitions.name: B_DREAM_EATER_LIQUID_OOZE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Dream Eater is affected by Liquid Ooze.

definitions.name: B_DREAM_EATER_SUBSTITUTE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Dream Eater can successfully hit and drain from a Substitute.

definitions.name: B_SNATCH
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Snatch no longer steals moves that were already stolen by another Pokémon's Snatch on the same turn.

definitions.name: B_FOCUS_PUNCH_FAILURE
definitions.upstream_comment: To determine if focus is lost: In Gen7+, check if the current move and the selected move are Focus Punch. In Gens5-6, check if the selected move is Focus Punch. In Gen4 and earlier, check if the current move is Focus Punch.

definitions.name: B_COUNTER_MIRROR_COAT_ALLY
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, an ally's attack does not count for uses of Counter/Mirror Coat/Metal Burst. In Gen4 and earlier, if the last attack taken was from an ally, Counter/Mirror Coat/Metal Burst would fail.

definitions.name: B_COUNTER_TRY_HIT_PARTNER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, if the user of the last attack is not on the field, it will be redirected to the partner. In Gen4 and earlier, Counter/Mirror Coat/Metal Burst would fail.

definitions.name: B_RAGE_BUILDS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, Rage's effect only sets in when it successfully hits. In Gen3, Rage's effect sets in regardless of whether it hits, misses or fails.

definitions.name: B_CHECK_USER_FAILURE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, The user of a move no longer checks for its own failure, e.g. Soundproof will not block its own Perish Song.

definitions.name: B_ABSORB_MESSAGE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, no absorb message is shown if user is already at full HP.

definitions.name: B_UPROAR
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Uproar awakens all battlers on the first turn if successful. In Gen3-4, Uproar allows every battler to awaken before their action or at the end of a turn.

definitions.name: B_FIRST_TURN_MOVE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Champions, Fake Out and First Impression cannot be selected past the user's first turn.

definitions.name: B_SALT_CURE_DAMAGE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9, Salt Cure deals 1/8 max HP (1/4 max HP to Steel and Water)

definitions.name: B_BELCH_SELECTABLE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6-9, Belch cannot be selected unless the user has eaten a Berry

definitions.name: B_STUFF_CHEEKS_SELECTABLE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8-9, Stuff Cheeks cannot be selected unless the user is holding a Berry

definitions.name: B_SPIT_UP_SELECTABLE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Champions, Spit Up cannot be selected unless the user has Stockpile stacks

definitions.name: B_MOVES_THAT_REMOVE_TYPE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Champions, Burn Up cannot be selected if the user is not Fire-type

definitions.name: B_LAST_RESORT_SELECTABLE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Champions, Last Resort cannot be selected if the user hasn't used all its other moves

definitions.name: B_FAINT_MOVE_EFFECT_TIMING
definitions.upstream_comment: In Champions, some move effects now apply even if the user faints from Rough Skin, Iron Barbs, etc.

definitions.name: B_SHEER_FORCE_AGAINST_ABILITIES
definitions.upstream_comment: As of Champions, Sheer Force no longer prevents the activation of Berserk and Pickpocket

definitions.name: B_ENCORE_PRIORITY
definitions.upstream_comment: In Champions, Encore uses the priority of the Encored move instead of the selected move

definitions.name: B_RAGE_FIST
definitions.upstream_comment: In Champions, Rage Fist stacks reset upon switching out or fainting

definitions.name: B_MOVE_EFFECTS_BEFORE_MOVES
definitions.upstream_comment: In Champions, Beak Blast will work when Encored into from a different move

definitions.name: B_GALE_WINGS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, Gale Wings requires full HP to trigger.

definitions.name: B_STANCE_CHANGE_FAIL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, Stance Change fails if the Pokémon is unable to use a move due to confusion, paralysis, etc.

definitions.name: B_SHADOW_TAG_ESCAPE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, if both sides have a Pokémon with Shadow Tag, all battlers can escape. Previously, neither side could escape this situation.

definitions.name: B_MOODY_ACC_EVASION
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, Moody can no longer raise accuracy and evasion.

definitions.name: B_FLASH_FIRE_FROZEN
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Flash Fire activates even when frozen.

definitions.name: B_SYNCHRONIZE_TOXIC
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, if a Pokémon with Synchronize is badly poisoned, the opponent will also become badly poisoned. Previously, the opponent would be inflicted with regular poison.

definitions.name: B_UPDATED_INTIMIDATE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, Intimidate no longer works on opponents with the Inner Focus, Scrappy, Own Tempo or Oblivious Abilities. It also activates Rattled.

definitions.name: B_OBLIVIOUS_TAUNT
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, Pokémon with Oblivious can no longer be taunted.

definitions.name: B_STURDY
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Sturdy causes a Pokémon to have 1 HP remaining if another Pokémon's attack or confusion damage would have knocked it out from full HP.

definitions.name: B_PLUS_MINUS_INTERACTION
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Plus and Minus can be activated by themselves in addition to the opposite Ability.

definitions.name: B_WEATHER_FORMS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Castform and Cherrim revert to their base form upon losing their respective Ability. Cherrim needs Flower Gift to change forms.

definitions.name: B_SYMBIOSIS_GEMS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, Symbiosis passes an item after a Gem-boosted attack. Previously, items were passed before the Gem-boosted attack hit, making the item's effect apply.

definitions.name: B_REDIRECT_ABILITY_IMMUNITY
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Pokémon with Lightning Rod/Storm Drain are immune to Electric-/Water-type moves and raises their Sp. Atk by 1 stage ontop of the redirecting effect.

definitions.name: B_REDIRECT_ABILITY_ALLIES
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, Lightning Rod and Storm Drain also redirect ally's moves.

definitions.name: B_LEAF_GUARD_PREVENTS_REST
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Leaf Guard prevents the use of Rest in the sun.

definitions.name: B_TRANSISTOR_BOOST
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, Transistor increases the power of Electric-type moves by 1.3x instead of 1.5x.

definitions.name: B_ILLUMINATE_EFFECT
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, Illuminate prevents accuracy from being lowered and ignores the target's evasion. Previously, it had no in-battle effect.

definitions.name: B_WEAK_ARMOR_SPEED
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, when hit by a physical move, Weak Armor raises Speed by 2 stages instead of 1.

definitions.name: B_PROTEAN_LIBERO
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, Protean and Libero trigger only once per Battle.

definitions.name: B_INTREPID_SWORD
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, Intrepid Sword triggers only once per battle.

definitions.name: B_DAUNTLESS_SHIELD
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, Dauntless Shield triggers only once per battle.

definitions.name: B_DISGUISE_HP_LOSS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, when a disguised Mimikyu's Disguise is busted, upon changing to its Busted Form, it loses 1/8 of its max HP.

definitions.name: B_ABILITY_TRIGGER_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, Shed Skin, Cute Charm, Flame Body, Static, and Poison Point have a 30% chance to trigger. Previously, it was 1/3.

definitions.name: B_PICKUP_WILD
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, Pickup allows its user to pick up its own used item at the end of the turn in wild battles.

definitions.name: B_MAGIC_GUARD
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4 only, Magic Guard ignores immobilization caused by paralysis.

definitions.name: B_BATTLE_BOND
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, Battle Bond raises Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed by 1 stage, once per battle. Previously, the Pokémon would change into Ash-Greninja.

definitions.name: B_ATE_MULTIPLIER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, -ate Abilities (Aerilate, Galvanize, Normalize, Pixilate, Refrigerate) increase damage by 1.2x. In Gen6 and earlier, it was 1.3x, except Normalize, which had no multiplier.

definitions.name: B_DEFIANT_STICKY_WEB
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, Defiant triggers on Sticky Web regardless of who set it up. In Gen8, it does not trigger on a Sticky Web set up by an ally after Court Change swaps its side.

definitions.name: B_MIRROR_ARMOR_STICKY_WEB
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, Mirror Armor does not reflect the Sticky Web stat change even if the original Sticky Web user is still on the field

definitions.name: B_POWDER_OVERCOAT
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, Overcoat blocks powder and spore moves.

definitions.name: B_INFILTRATOR_SUBSTITUTE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, Infiltrator bypasses Substitute when using a move, excluding Transform and Sky Drop.

definitions.name: B_DANCER_ORDER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, Dancer activations are based on Speed order including modifiers. In Gen7, Dancer activates from the slowest to fastest battler based on the battler's unmodified Speed stat.

definitions.name: B_UNSEEN_FIST_PIERCING_DRILL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8-9, Unseen Fist/Piercing Drill deals 100% of the damage dealt to protected targets while also bypassing the contact effects of protect moves.

definitions.name: B_WRAP_TURNS
definitions.upstream_comment: Max number of turns with a Grip Claw.

definitions.name: B_CONFUSE_BERRIES_HEAL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, Figy and similar Berries heal 1/3 of max HP and activate at 25% HP. In Gen7, they restore half HP and activate at 25% HP. In Gen6 and earlier, they restore 1/8 of max HP and activate at half HP.

definitions.name: B_X_ITEMS_BUFF
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, X items raise a stat by 2 stages instead of 1.

definitions.name: B_X_ITEMS_CROSSUSE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen3, you can only use X items on the current battler, but in Gen7 you can use an X item on any friendly battler in double battles (we are not sure in which gen the change occured)

definitions.name: B_MENTAL_HERB
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Mental Herb cures Taunt, Encore, Torment, Heal Block, and Disable in addition to Infatuation from before.

definitions.name: B_TRAINERS_KNOCK_OFF_ITEMS
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, Trainers can steal/swap your items (non-berries are restored after battle). In vanilla games, Trainers cannot steal items outside of facilities.

definitions.name: B_RETURN_STOLEN_NPC_ITEMS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Thief and Covet no longer permanently steal items from NPCs.

definitions.name: B_STEAL_WILD_ITEMS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, Thief and Covet steal a wild Pokémon's item and send it to the Bag. In Gen8 and earlier, the stolen item would be held by the Thief/Covet user.

definitions.name: B_RESTORE_HELD_BATTLE_ITEMS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, all non-Berry items are restored after battle.

definitions.name: B_SOUL_DEW_BOOST
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, Soul Dew increases the power of the Latis' Psychic- and Dragon-type moves by ~20%. In Gen6 and earlier, it increased their Sp. Atk and Sp. Def by 50% each.

definitions.name: B_NET_BALL_MODIFIER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, Net Ball's catch multiplier is 5x instead of 3x.

definitions.name: B_DIVE_BALL_MODIFIER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, Dive Ball's effectiveness increases when Surfing or Fishing in addition to Diving.

definitions.name: B_NEST_BALL_MODIFIER
definitions.upstream_comment: Nest Ball's formula varies depending on the generation. See Cmd_handleballthrow.

definitions.name: B_REPEAT_BALL_MODIFIER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, Repeat Ball's catch multiplier is 3.5x instead of 3x.

definitions.name: B_TIMER_BALL_MODIFIER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Timer Ball's effectiveness increases by 0.3x per turn instead of 0.1x.

definitions.name: B_DUSK_BALL_MODIFIER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, Dusk Ball's catch multiplier is 3x instead of 3.5x.

definitions.name: B_QUICK_BALL_MODIFIER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Quick Ball's catch multiplier is 5x instead of 4x.

definitions.name: B_LURE_BALL_MODIFIER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, Lure Ball's catch multiplier is 4x. In Gen7, it's 5x. In Gen6 and earlier, it's 3x.

definitions.name: B_HEAVY_BALL_MODIFIER
definitions.upstream_comment: Heavy Ball's ranges. See Cmd_handleballthrow.

definitions.name: B_DREAM_BALL_MODIFIER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, Dream Ball's catch multiplier is 4x when the target is asleep or has the Ability Comatose.

definitions.name: B_SPORT_BALL_MODIFIER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, Sport Ball's catch multiplier was reduced from 1.5x to 1x.

definitions.name: B_SAFARI_BALL_MODIFIER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, Safari Ball's catch multiplier is 1x. In Gens2-6, it's 1.5x. In Gen1, it's 2x.

definitions.name: B_FRIEND_BALL_MODIFIER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, the initial friendship of Pokémon caught in a Friend Ball friendship was reduced from 200 to 150.

definitions.name: B_SERENE_GRACE_BOOST
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Serene Grace boosts the added flinch chance of King's Rock and Razor Fang.

definitions.name: B_IRON_BALL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, Flying-type Pokémon holding an Iron Ball take neutral damage from Ground-type moves regardless of their other types, except during Inverse Battles or if the Pokémon is grounded by any other effect.

definitions.name: B_FLAG_BADGE_BOOST_ATTACK
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set and B_BADGE_BOOST == GEN_3, it will increase the Attack of the player's Pokémon.

definitions.name: B_FLAG_BADGE_BOOST_DEFENSE
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set and B_BADGE_BOOST == GEN_3, it will increase the Defense of the player's Pokémon.

definitions.name: B_FLAG_BADGE_BOOST_SPEED
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set and B_BADGE_BOOST == GEN_3, it will increase the Speed of the player's Pokémon.

definitions.name: B_FLAG_BADGE_BOOST_SPATK
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set and B_BADGE_BOOST == GEN_3, it will increase the Sp. Atk of the player's Pokémon.

definitions.name: B_FLAG_BADGE_BOOST_SPDEF
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set and B_BADGE_BOOST == GEN_3, it will increase the Sp. Def of the player's Pokémon.

definitions.name: B_FLAG_INVERSE_BATTLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, the battle's type chart inverted. For example, Fire is super effective against Water.

definitions.name: B_FLAG_AI_VS_AI_BATTLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, the player's Pokémon will be controlled by the AI in the next battle.

definitions.name: B_FLAG_DYNAMAX_BATTLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, the ability to Dynamax in battle is enabled for all Trainers.

definitions.name: B_FLAG_TERA_ORB_CHARGED
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, the Tera Orb is charged. It is automatically set upon healing and cleared upon Terastallizing once configured.

definitions.name: B_FLAG_TERA_ORB_NO_COST
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, the Tera Orb does not use up its charge upon Terastallization. In SV, this occurs after an event with Terapagos.

definitions.name: B_FLAG_SLEEP_CLAUSE
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, sleep clause is enabled; if a Pokémon on the one side of the field is asleep, another one on that side cannot be put to sleep. AI requires AI_FLAG_CHECK_BAD_MOVE to understand.

definitions.name: B_FLAG_NO_WHITEOUT
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, the player can not white out against Trainers. Please note that the party is not healed automatically!

definitions.name: B_VAR_WILD_AI_FLAGS
definitions.upstream_comment: If not 0, you can use this var to add to default wild AI flags. IMPORTANT: NOT usable with flags above (1 << 15)

definitions.name: B_VAR_DIFFICULTY
definitions.upstream_comment: If not 0, you can use this var to control which difficulty version of a Trainer is loaded. This should be manually set by the developer using Script_SetDifficulty AFTER NewGameInitData has run.

definitions.name: B_VAR_NO_BAG_USE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to 1, the ability to use the Bag is disabled in Trainer battles. If set to 2, it is also disabled in wild battles.

definitions.name: B_FLAG_SKY_BATTLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag has a value, the player will be able to engage in scripted Sky Battles.

definitions.name: B_VAR_SKY_BATTLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If this var has a value, the game will remember the positions of Pokémon used in Sky Battles.

definitions.name: B_SKY_BATTLE_STRICT_ELIGIBILITY
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, Sky Battles will use the eligibility from X and Y. If FALSE, all Flying-types and Pokémon with Levitate are allowed.

definitions.name: B_RESET_FLAGS_VARS_AFTER_WHITEOUT
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, Overworld_ResetBattleFlagsAndVars will reset battle-related flags and vars when the player whites out.

definitions.name: B_SHOW_PARTNER_TARGET
definitions.upstream_comment: Shows the battler partner will target.

definitions.name: B_SHOW_MOVE_DESCRIPTION
definitions.upstream_comment: Shows move information in battler

definitions.name: B_ABILITY_WEATHER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, Ability-induced weather lasts 5 turns. In Gen5 and earlier, it lasted until the battle ended or until it was changed by another weather condition.

definitions.name: B_SANDSTORM_SPDEF_BOOST
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, sandstorm increases the Sp. Def of Rock-type Pokémon by 1.5x.

definitions.name: B_SANDSTORM_SOLAR_BEAM
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen3+, sandstorm decreases the power of Solar Beam.

definitions.name: B_OVERWORLD_FOG
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, overworld fog summons Misty Terrain in battle. In Gen4 only, overworld fog summons the unique fog weather condition in battle.

definitions.name: B_OVERWORLD_SNOW
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, overworld snow will summon snow instead of hail in battle.

definitions.name: B_SNOW_WARNING
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, Snow Warning will summon snow instead of hail.

definitions.name: B_PREFERRED_ICE_WEATHER
definitions.upstream_comment: Toggles hail move effects to snow and vice versa.

definitions.name: B_OVERWORLD_WEATHER_OVERRIDE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, overworld weather cannot be overridden.

definitions.name: B_TERRAIN_BG_CHANGE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, terrain moves permanently change the default battle background until the effect fades.

definitions.name: B_THUNDERSTORM_TERRAIN
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, overworld Thunderstorm summons rain and Electric Terrain as in Gen8.

definitions.name: B_TERRAIN_TYPE_BOOST
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, terrain increases the power of same-type moves by 30% instead of 50%.

definitions.name: B_SECRET_POWER_EFFECT
definitions.upstream_comment: Secret Power's effects change depending on the terrain and generation. See MOVE_EFFECT_SECRET_POWER's case in `SetMoveEffect`.

definitions.name: B_SECRET_POWER_ANIMATION
definitions.upstream_comment: Secret Power's animations change depending on the terrain and generation.

definitions.name: B_NATURE_POWER_MOVES
definitions.upstream_comment: Nature Power calls different moves depending on the terrain and generation. See gBattleEnvironmentInfo.

definitions.name: B_CAMOUFLAGE_TYPES
definitions.upstream_comment: Camouflage changes the user to different types depending on the terrain and generation. See sTerrainToType.

definitions.name: B_NEW_TERRAIN_BACKGROUNDS
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, uses new terrain backgrounds for Electric, Misty, Grassy and Psychic Terrain.

definitions.name: B_FAST_INTRO_PKMN_TEXT
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, battle intro text prints at the same time as the animation of Pokémon, as opposing to waiting for the animation to end.

definitions.name: B_FAST_INTRO_NO_SLIDE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, the slide animation that happens at the beginning of battles is skipped.

definitions.name: B_FAST_HP_DRAIN
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, HP bars will move faster.

definitions.name: B_FAST_EXP_GROW
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, EXP bars will move faster.

definitions.name: B_SHOW_TARGETS
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, all available targets will be shown before selecting a move in Double Battles.

definitions.name: B_SHOW_CATEGORY_ICON
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, an icon in the summary and move relearner will show a move's category.

definitions.name: B_HIDE_HEALTHBOX_IN_ANIMS
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, healthboxes will be hidden during move animations.

definitions.name: B_WAIT_TIME_MULTIPLIER
definitions.upstream_comment: This determines how long text pauses for in battle. Vanilla is 16. Lower values result in faster battles.

definitions.name: B_QUICK_MOVE_CURSOR_TO_RUN
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, pushing B in the battle menu in a wild encounter will move the cursor to the Run option.

definitions.name: B_RUN_TRAINER_BATTLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, players can run from Trainer battles as in Gen9+. This is treated as a white out.

definitions.name: B_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BUTTON
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to a button other than B_LAST_USED_BALL_BUTTON, pressing this button will open the move description menu.

definitions.name: B_SHOW_USELESS_Z_MOVE_INFO
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, Z-Moves without additional effects, like newer generation status moves, will say "No additional effect."

definitions.name: B_ANIMATE_MON_AFTER_KO
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, if a Pokémon on the opposing side faints, the non-fainted Pokémon will play their animations.

definitions.name: B_ANIMATE_MON_AFTER_FAILED_POKEBALL
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, a wild Pokémon that breaks of a thrown Poké Ball will play its animation.

definitions.name: B_SHOW_DYNAMAX_MESSAGE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, an additional battle message is shown after Dynamaxing or Gigantamaxing.

definitions.name: B_HPBAR_COLOR_THRESHOLD
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, HP bar color thresholds were changed to be based on the actual HP values instead of the pixel length of the HP bar, leading to more accurate HP bar colors.

definitions.name: B_HP_PERCENTAGE_DISPLAY
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, Pokémon on the opposing side's HP will be displayed in percentage alongside the HP bar. In single battles, this extends the healthbox to add the percentage below the HP bar. In double battles, the same input used to toggle your side's HP values will also toggle the opposing side's percentage display.

definitions.name: B_SEMI_INVULNERABLE_CATCH
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, you cannot throw a ball against a Pokémon that is in a semi-invulnerable state (Dig/Fly/etc).

definitions.name: B_CATCHING_CHARM_BOOST
definitions.upstream_comment: % increase in critical capture odds if the player has the Catching Charm.

definitions.name: B_INCAPACITATED_CATCH_BONUS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, the catch rate bonus for a sleeping or frozen Pokémon is 2.5x instead of 2x.

definitions.name: B_LOW_LEVEL_CATCH_BONUS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, a bonus is added to the catch rate when catching a Pokémon lower than level 13. In Gen8, the bonus is applied to Pokémon lower than level 20.

definitions.name: B_MISSING_BADGE_CATCH_MALUS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, a penalty is added to the catch rate when trying to catch a Pokémon 5 levels above the current obedience level, based on the number of Badges obtained.

definitions.name: B_CRITICAL_CAPTURE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, Critical Captures will be enabled.

definitions.name: B_CRITICAL_CAPTURE_LOCAL_DEX
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to FALSE, the Critical Capture chance is based off of the National Pokédex, estimated by enabled generations.

definitions.name: B_CRITICAL_CAPTURE_IF_OWNED
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, a capture will appear critical if the Pokémon you're trying to catch is of a species that you have already caught.

definitions.name: B_FLAG_VICTORY_CATCH_RANDOM
definitions.upstream_comment: If set, you will be prompted to throw a ball after the encounter has been defeated, catch rate is random. You can't capture the encounter in any other way.

definitions.name: B_FLAG_VICTORY_CATCH_GUARANTEED
definitions.upstream_comment: If set, you will be prompted to throw a ball after the encounter has been defeated, guaranteed to catch. You can't capture the encounter in any other way.

definitions.name: B_LAST_USED_BALL
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, the "last used Ball" feature from Gen7+ will be implemented

definitions.name: B_LAST_USED_BALL_BUTTON
definitions.upstream_comment: If last used Ball is implemented, this button (or button combination) will trigger throwing the last used Ball.

definitions.name: B_LAST_USED_BALL_CYCLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, then holding B_LAST_USED_BALL_BUTTON while pressing the D-Pad cycles through the Balls.

definitions.name: B_CATCH_SWAP_INTO_PARTY
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, the option to swap caught Pokémon into the party will appear, allowing you to send a different Pokémon to the Box.

definitions.name: B_CATCH_SWAP_CHECK_HMS
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, the catch swap feature above will prevent returning Pokémon to the Box if they know HMs.

definitions.name: B_MULTI_BATTLE_WHITEOUT
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, Multi Battles end when the player as well as their partner don't have any Pokémon left.

definitions.name: B_EVOLUTION_AFTER_WHITEOUT
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, Pokémon that qualify for evolution after battle will evolve even if the player loses.

definitions.name: B_AFFECTION_MECHANICS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, there's a stat called affection that can trigger different effects in battle. From LGPE onwards, these effects use friendship instead.

definitions.name: B_TRAINER_CLASS_POKE_BALLS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, Trainers will use certain kinds of Poké Balls depending on their Trainer class.

definitions.name: B_TRAINER_MON_RANDOM_ABILITY
definitions.upstream_comment: If this is set to 0, trainers mons with no set ability only use the first ability of a mon. If set to 1 it will roll a random non-hidden ability. If set to 2, it will roll any ability (including hidden ability) with equal chance

definitions.name: B_OBEDIENCE_MECHANICS
definitions.upstream_comment: In PLA onwards (GEN_8 here), obedience restrictions also apply to non-outsider Pokémon, albeit based on their met level rather than their current level.

definitions.name: B_USE_FROSTBITE
definitions.upstream_comment: In PLA, Frostbite replaces Freeze. Enabling this flag does the same here. Moves can still be cherry-picked to either Freeze or Frostbite. Freeze-Dry, Secret Power & Tri Attack depend on this config.

definitions.name: B_TOXIC_REVERSAL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, bad poison will change to regular poison at the end of battles.

definitions.name: B_TRY_CATCH_TRAINER_BALL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, trying to catch a Trainer's Pokémon no longers consume the Poké Ball.

definitions.name: B_SLEEP_CLAUSE
definitions.upstream_comment: Enables Sleep Clause all the time in every case, overriding B_FLAG_SLEEP_CLAUSE. Use that for modularity.

definitions.name: B_PARTNER_MONS_MARKED_SEEN
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, if your Double Battle partner sends out a Pokémon you haven't encountered yet, it will be marked as SEEN in your Pokédex.

definitions.name: B_MULTI_HALF_TEAMS
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, trainers will be capped at 3 Pokémon each when there are 2 trainers on one side in a battle. If FALSE, per-battle capping may still be set using `Multi Party: Half` in `trainers.party`

definitions.name: B_TERA_ORB_ALWAYS_CHARGED
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, causes the Tera Orb to always be charged all the time in every case, overriding B_FLAG_TERA_ORB_CHARGED. Use that for modularity.

definitions.name: NUM_BEEPS_GEN_LATEST
definitions.upstream_comment: Loops 4 times

definitions.name: NUM_BEEPS_GEN_3
definitions.upstream_comment: Loops infinitely

definitions.name: NUM_BEEPS_OFF
definitions.upstream_comment: Does not play at all

definitions.name: B_NUM_LOW_HEALTH_BEEPS
definitions.upstream_comment: This controls the number of times the "low HP" beep will loop. Setting this value to NUM_BEEPS_OFF will disable the beep, while NUM_BEEPS_GEN_3 will loop infinitely. You can set this to any number you want, the defines listed are just for ease of use.

definitions.name: B_NEW_SWORD_PARTICLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, it updates Swords Dance's particle.

definitions.name: B_NEW_LEECH_SEED_PARTICLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, it updates Leech Seed's particle.

definitions.name: B_NEW_HORN_ATTACK_PARTICLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, it updates Horn Attack's horn particle.

definitions.name: B_NEW_ROCKS_PARTICLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, it updates rock particles.

definitions.name: B_NEW_LEAF_PARTICLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, it updates the leaf particle.

definitions.name: B_NEW_EMBER_PARTICLES
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, it updates Ember's fire particle.

definitions.name: B_NEW_MEAN_LOOK_PARTICLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, it updates Mean Look's eye particle.

definitions.name: B_NEW_TEETH_PARTICLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, it updates Bite/Crunch teeth particle.

definitions.name: B_NEW_HANDS_FEET_PARTICLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, it updates chop/kick/punch particles.

definitions.name: B_NEW_SPIKES_PARTICLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, it updates Spikes' particle.

definitions.name: B_NEW_FLY_BUBBLE_PARTICLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, it updates Fly's 'bubble' particle.

definitions.name: B_NEW_CURSE_NAIL_PARTICLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, it updates Curse's nail particle.

definitions.name: B_NEW_BATON_PASS_BALL_PARTICLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, it updates Baton Pass' Poké Ball particle.

definitions.name: B_NEW_MORNING_SUN_STAR_PARTICLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, it updates Morning Sun's star particles.

definitions.name: B_NEW_IMPACT_PALETTE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, it updates the basic impact palette.

definitions.name: B_NEW_SURF_PARTICLE_PALETTE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, it updates Surf's wave palette.

definitions.name: B_ENEMY_THROW_BALLS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, enemy Trainers throw Poké Balls into battle instead of them just appearing on the ground and opening.

definitions.name: B_ENEMY_THROW_BALLS_SOUND
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, enemy Trainer's Poké Balls make a sound when thrown to send out a Pokémon. This can only be used when B_ENEMY_THROW_BALLS is set to GEN_6 or later.

definitions.name: B_PLAYER_THROW_BALLS_SOUND
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen5+, the player's Poké Balls make a sound when thrown to send out a Pokémon.

definitions.name: SHOW_TYPES_NEVER
definitions.upstream_comment: Never show types in battle.

definitions.name: SHOW_TYPES_ALWAYS
definitions.upstream_comment: Always show types in battle.

definitions.name: SHOW_TYPES_CAUGHT
definitions.upstream_comment: Only show types if you've caught a Pokémon of that species.

definitions.name: SHOW_TYPES_SEEN
definitions.upstream_comment: Only show types if you've seen a Pokémon of that species.

definitions.name: B_SHOW_TYPES
definitions.upstream_comment: When to show type indicators next to Pokémon HP bars, while choosing a move after selecting a target Pokémon.

definitions.name: SHOW_EFFECTIVENESS_NEVER
definitions.upstream_comment: Never show type effectiveness when selecting moves.

definitions.name: SHOW_EFFECTIVENESS_ALWAYS
definitions.upstream_comment: Always show type effectiveness when selecting moves.

definitions.name: SHOW_EFFECTIVENESS_CAUGHT
definitions.upstream_comment: Only show type effectiveness if you've caught a Pokémon of that species.

definitions.name: SHOW_EFFECTIVENESS_SEEN
definitions.upstream_comment: Only show type effectiveness if you've seen a Pokémon of that species.

definitions.name: B_SHOW_EFFECTIVENESS
definitions.upstream_comment: If not SHOW_EFFECTIVENESS_NEVER, the PP string is replaced by a type effectiveness indicator based on the move and the target.

definitions.name: B_ENEMY_MON_SHADOW_STYLE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, all opposing Pokémon will have a shadow drawn beneath them.

definitions.name: B_MOVE_REARRANGEMENT_IN_BATTLE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, move slots can no longer be rearranged in battle.

definitions.name: B_POOL_SETTING_CONSISTENT_RNG
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, the same Trainer will always generate the same pool on the same save file.

definitions.name: B_POOL_SETTING_USE_FIXED_SEED
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, RNG will use the fixed seed defined in B_POOL_SETTING_FIXED_SEED.

definitions.name: B_POOL_SETTING_FIXED_SEED
definitions.upstream_comment: "Random" number. Unless a mistake was made, it's へだら in the Emerald charmap, which should spell he-da-ra.

definitions.name: B_POOL_RULE_SPECIES_CLAUSE
definitions.upstream_comment: Only pick a single Pokémon of a unique National Pokédex number.

definitions.name: B_POOL_RULE_EXCLUDE_FORMS
definitions.upstream_comment: Exclude different forms from Species Clause.

definitions.name: B_POOL_RULE_ITEM_CLAUSE
definitions.upstream_comment: Only allow each item to be picked once.

definitions.name: B_POOL_RULES_USE_ITEM_EXCLUSIONS
definitions.upstream_comment: Exclude items listed in poolItemClauseExclusions.

definitions.name: B_POOL_RULE_MEGA_STONE_CLAUSE
definitions.upstream_comment: Pick only 1 Pokémon with a Mega Stone.

definitions.name: B_POOL_RULE_Z_CRYSTAL_CLAUSE
definitions.upstream_comment: Pick only 1 Pokémon with a Z-Crystal.

definitions.name: EXP_CAP_NONE
definitions.upstream_comment: Regular behavior, no level caps are applied

definitions.name: EXP_CAP_HARD
definitions.upstream_comment: Pokémon with a level >= the level cap cannot gain any experience

definitions.name: EXP_CAP_SOFT
definitions.upstream_comment: Pokémon with a level >= the level cap will gain reduced experience

definitions.name: LEVEL_CAP_NONE
definitions.upstream_comment: No level cap, only applicable if B_EXP_CAP_TYPE is EXP_CAP_NONE

definitions.name: LEVEL_CAP_FLAG_LIST
definitions.upstream_comment: Level cap is chosen according to the first unset flag in `sLevelCapFlagMap`

definitions.name: LEVEL_CAP_VARIABLE
definitions.upstream_comment: Level cap is chosen according to the contents of the event variable specified by B_LEVEL_CAP_VARIABLE

definitions.name: B_EXP_CAP_TYPE
definitions.upstream_comment: [EXP_CAP_NONE, EXP_CAP_HARD, EXP_CAP_SOFT] choose the type of level cap to apply

definitions.name: B_LEVEL_CAP_TYPE
definitions.upstream_comment: [LEVEL_CAP_NONE, LEVEL_CAP_FLAG_LIST, LEVEL_CAP_VARIABLE] choose the method to derive the level cap

definitions.name: B_LEVEL_CAP_VARIABLE
definitions.upstream_comment: event variable used to derive level cap if B_LEVEL_CAP_TYPE is set to LEVEL_CAP_VARIABLE

definitions.name: B_RARE_CANDY_CAP
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to true, Rare Candies can't be used to go over the level cap

definitions.name: B_LEVEL_CAP_EXP_UP
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to true, mons under level cap will receive more experience

definitions.name: EV_CAP_NONE
definitions.upstream_comment: Regular behavior, no EV caps are applied

definitions.name: EV_CAP_FLAG_LIST
definitions.upstream_comment: EV cap is chosen according to the first unset flag in `sEVCapFlagMap`

definitions.name: EV_CAP_VARIABLE
definitions.upstream_comment: EV cap is chosen according to the contents of the event variable specified by B_EV_CAP_VARIABLE

definitions.name: EV_CAP_NO_GAIN
definitions.upstream_comment: No EVs can be gained

definitions.name: B_EV_CAP_TYPE
definitions.upstream_comment: [EV_CAP_NONE, EV_CAP_FLAG_LIST, EV_CAP_VARIABLE, EV_CAP_NO_GAIN] choose the type of EV cap to apply#define B_EV_CAP_VARIABLE               12 // event variable used to derive EV cap if B_EV_CAP_TYPE is set to EV_CAP_VARIABLE

definitions.name: B_EV_CAP_VARIABLE
definitions.upstream_comment: event variable used to derive EV cap if B_EV_CAP_TYPE is set to EV_CAP_VARIABLE

definitions.name: B_EV_ITEMS_CAP
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to true, EV-boosting items can't be used to go over the EV cap

definitions.name: C_HIDE_CONTEST_DATA
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, hides contest data in summary screen and move relearner.

definitions.name: C_UPDATED_MOVE_CATEGORIES
definitions.upstream_comment: Updates contest category.

definitions.name: C_UPDATED_MOVE_EFFECTS
definitions.upstream_comment: Updates contest effects.

definitions.name: DEBUG_OVERWORLD_MENU
definitions.upstream_comment: Enables an overworld debug menu to change flags, variables, giving Pokémon and more, accessed by holding R and pressing START while in the overworld by default.

definitions.name: DEBUG_OVERWORLD_HELD_KEYS
definitions.upstream_comment: The keys required to be held to open the debug menu.

definitions.name: DEBUG_OVERWORLD_TRIGGER_EVENT
definitions.upstream_comment: The event that opens the menu when holding the key(s) defined in DEBUG_OVERWORLD_HELD_KEYS.

definitions.name: DEBUG_OVERWORLD_IN_MENU
definitions.upstream_comment: Replaces the overworld debug menu button combination with a start menu entry (above Pokédex).

definitions.name: DEBUG_BATTLE_MENU
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, enables a debug menu to use in battles by pressing the Select button.

definitions.name: DEBUG_AI_DELAY_TIMER
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, displays the number of frames it takes for the AI to choose a move. Replaces the "What will PKMN do" text. Useful for devs or anyone who modifies the AI code and wants to see if it doesn't take too long to run.

definitions.name: DEBUG_POKEMON_SPRITE_VISUALIZER
definitions.upstream_comment: Enables a debug menu for Pokémon sprites and icons, accessed by pressing Select in the summary screen.

definitions.name: DEXNAV_ENABLED
definitions.upstream_comment: Whether or not DexNav is enabled. If TRUE, flags/vars below must all be non-zero

definitions.name: USE_DEXNAV_SEARCH_LEVELS
definitions.declared_value: FALSE  /* WARNING: POSSIBLY EXCEEDS SAVEBLOCK SPACE! REQUIRES 1 BYTE PER SPECIES */

definitions.name: DN_FLAG_SEARCHING
definitions.upstream_comment: Searching for mon

definitions.name: DN_FLAG_DEXNAV_GET
definitions.upstream_comment: DexNav shows in start menu

definitions.name: DN_FLAG_DETECTOR_MODE
definitions.upstream_comment: Allow player to find hidden mons

definitions.name: DN_VAR_SPECIES
definitions.upstream_comment: Registered DexNav species

definitions.name: DN_VAR_STEP_COUNTER
definitions.upstream_comment: Steps for finding hidden Pokémon

definitions.name: DEXNAV_TIMEOUT
definitions.upstream_comment: 15 seconds is the time out. Max of 1092 seconds allowed

definitions.name: SNEAKING_PROXIMITY
definitions.upstream_comment: Tile amount

definitions.name: DEXNAV_CHAIN_MAX
definitions.upstream_comment: maximum chain value

definitions.name: HIDDEN_MON_STEP_COUNT
definitions.upstream_comment: Look for hidden Pokémon every x steps

definitions.name: HIDDEN_MON_SEARCH_RATE
definitions.upstream_comment: x% chance of finding hidden Pokémon every x steps

definitions.name: HIDDEN_MON_PROBABILTY
definitions.upstream_comment: x% chance of finding hidden mon compared to regular encounter data

definitions.name: I_FISHING_BITE_ODDS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen 1 and Gen 2, the Old Rod has a 100% chance for a bite, Good Rod has a 66% chance for a bite, and Super Rod has a 50% chance for a bite. In Gen 3, all rods have a base 50% chance for a bite. In Gen 4 onwards, the Old Rod has a base 25% chance for a bite, Good Rod has a 50% chance for a bite, and Super Rod has a 75% chance for a bite.

definitions.name: I_FISHING_MINIGAME
definitions.upstream_comment: Each generation uses a variation of reeling in Pokémon once they have been hooked. NOTE: Only the Gen 1/2 and Gen 3 minigames are implemented right now!

definitions.name: I_FISHING_ENVIRONMENT
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen 3, the battle environment when fighting a hooked Pokémon is based on the tile the player is standing on. In Gen 4 onwards, the environment is based on tile that is being fished in, resulting in it usually being a water environment.

definitions.name: I_FISHING_STICKY_BOOST
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen 3, a Pokemon with Suction Cups or Sticky Hold in the first slot of the party causes the chance for a bite to increase by about 35%. In Gen 4 onwards, it doubles the base bite chance.

definitions.name: I_FISHING_FOLLOWER_BOOST
definitions.upstream_comment: In HGSS, fishing bite odds are increased depending on the friendship of the current following Pokémon.

definitions.name: I_FISHING_CHAIN
definitions.upstream_comment: Introduced in XY, hooking the same Pokémon repeatedly will increase the odds of that mon being shiny. NOTE: This implementation is an approximation of the actual feature, as XY have not been throughoutly documented or datamined.

definitions.name: I_FISHING_PROXIMITY
definitions.upstream_comment: In XY, bite chance is boosted by the number of adjacent non-surfable tiles next to your fishing line

definitions.name: I_FISHING_TIME_OF_DAY_BOOST
definitions.upstream_comment: In XY, bite chance is boosted during morning and evening

definitions.name: FNPC_ENABLE_NPC_FOLLOWERS
definitions.upstream_comment: Enables the use of script macros to designate NPCs to follow behind the player, DPP style. Slightly increases the size of the saveblock (SaveBlock3).

definitions.name: FNPC_FLAG_HEAL_AFTER_FOLLOWER_BATTLE
definitions.upstream_comment: Replace the 0 with a flag in order to use that flag to toggle whether the Player's party will be automatically healed after every follower partner battle. If you want this to always be active without using a flag, replace 0 with FNPC_ALWAYS.

definitions.name: FNPC_FLAG_PARTNER_WILD_BATTLES
definitions.upstream_comment: Replace the 0 with a flag in order to use that flag to toggle whether the follower partner will join you for wild battles. If you want this to always be active without using a flag, replace 0 with FNPC_ALWAYS.

definitions.name: FNPC_NPC_FOLLOWER_WILD_BATTLE_VS_2
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, two wild Pokemon will show up to the partner battle instead of just one.

definitions.name: FNPC_NPC_FOLLOWER_PARTY_PREVIEW
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, a preview of the player's and partner's teams will be shown before every trainer battle.

definitions.name: FNPC_FACE_NPC_FOLLOWER_ON_DOOR_EXIT
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, the player will turn to face the follower when they exit a doorway.

definitions.name: FNPC_NPC_FOLLOWER_SHOW_AFTER_LEAVE_ROUTE
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, the follower will reappear and walk out of the player after using Fly, Escape Rope, or Teleport.

definitions.name: EXPANSION_INTRO
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, a custom RHH intro will play after the vanilla copyright screen.

definitions.name: PHONEMES_SHARED
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, bard phonemes all reference the same sound (sound/direct_sound_samples/phonemes/shared.bin) to save ROM space.

definitions.name: UNITS_IMPERIAL
definitions.upstream_comment: Inches, feet, pounds

definitions.name: UNITS_METRIC
definitions.upstream_comment: meters, kilograms

definitions.name: CHAR_DEC_SEPARATOR
definitions.upstream_comment: CHAR_PERIOD is used as a decimal separator only in the UK and the US. The rest of the world uses CHAR_COMMA.

definitions.name: AUTO_LOWERCASE_KEYBOARD
definitions.upstream_comment: Starting in GEN_6, after entering the first uppercase character, the keyboard switches to lowercase letters.

definitions.name: I_SHINY_CHARM_ADDITIONAL_ROLLS
definitions.upstream_comment: The amount of additional Shiny rolls if the player has the Shiny Charm. Set it to 0 to disable the Shiny Charm's effects.

definitions.name: I_KEY_FOSSILS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, fossils are no longer Key Items.

definitions.name: I_KEY_ESCAPE_ROPE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, the Escape Rope is a Key Item. Keep in mind that this will make it free to buy in Marts.

definitions.name: I_HEALTH_RECOVERY
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, certain healing items recover a different amount of HP than they did previously.

definitions.name: I_SITRUS_BERRY_HEAL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, Sitrus Berries heal 30 HP instead of 25% of max HP.

definitions.name: I_VITAMIN_EV_CAP
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, Vitamins no longer have a cap of 100 EVs per stat.

definitions.name: I_BERRY_EV_JUMP
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4 only, EV-lowering Berries lower a stat's EVs to 100 if they are above 100.

definitions.name: I_GRISEOUS_ORB_FORM_CHANGE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, the Griseous Orb no longer changes Giratina's form when held.

definitions.name: I_GEM_BOOST_POWER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, the power multiplier of Gems is 1.3x instead of 1.5x.

definitions.name: I_USE_EVO_HELD_ITEMS_FROM_BAG
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, items such as the Electirizer can be used from the bag to evolve a Pokémon like in PLA.

definitions.name: I_TYPE_BOOST_POWER
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, type-enhancing held items increase the power of moves by 1.2x instead of 1.1x (1.05x in the case of Sea Incense).

definitions.name: I_SELL_VALUE_FRACTION
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, items sell for 1/4 of their value instead of 1/2.

definitions.name: I_PRICE
definitions.upstream_comment: Some items have varied in value across generations. See src/data/items.h for values.

definitions.name: I_BERRY_PRICE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, the value of Berries increased since they can no longer be planted.

definitions.name: I_POWER_ITEM_BOOST
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen7+, Pokémon holding Power items gain 8 extra EVs instead of 4.

definitions.name: I_PREMIER_BALL_BONUS
definitions.upstream_comment: In LGPE onwards (Gen8+ here), the player is given a Premier Ball for every 10 Poké Balls of any type in the same purchase. Previously, this only applied to regular Poké Balls and only 1 could be obtained per purchase.

definitions.name: I_ROTOM_CATALOG_THUNDER_SHOCK
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen9+, changing Rotom to its base form will teach it Thunder Shock even if it knows another move.

definitions.name: I_REPEL_INCLUDE_FAINTED
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen1 and Gen6+, Repels use the level of the first party member to check which wild Pokémon to prevent encounters with, even if that member is fainted. In Gens2-5, they use the level of the first non-fainted Pokémon.

definitions.name: I_LAX_INCENSE_BOOST
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, Lax Incense lowers accuracy by 10% instead of 5%.

definitions.name: I_REUSABLE_TMS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gens5-8, TMs are reusable. Setting this to TRUE will make all vanilla TMs reusable, though they can also be cherry-picked by setting their importance to 1.

definitions.name: I_EXP_SHARE_FLAG
