definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, every Pokémon in the party will gain experience, regardless if they participated in the battle or not.

definitions.name: I_EXP_SHARE_ITEM
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen6+, the Exp. Share is a Key item that toggles the effect described above.

definitions.name: VAR_LAST_REPEL_LURE_USED
definitions.upstream_comment: If this var has been assigned, the last Repel/Lure used will be saved and the player will be prompted with the vanilla repel YES/NO option, unless I_REPEL_LURE_MENU is set to TRUE.

definitions.name: I_REPEL_LURE_MENU
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, the player is able to choose which Repel/Lure to use once the previous one runs out. Cursor position is saved by VAR_LAST_REPEL_LURE_USED if not 0.

definitions.name: I_VS_SEEKER_CHARGING
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is assigned, the Vs. Seeker functionality will be enabled. When the player has the Vs. Seeker, Match Call rematch functions will stop working. Documentation for the Vs. Seeker can be found in docs/tutorials/vs_seeker.md.

definitions.name: I_SHOW_NO_ID_TRAINER
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, object events with a trainer type but no visible trainer id will be shown with a question mark. You may want to add vsseeker_rematchid TRAINER_ID as the top of the script to let the VS seeker know what reaction it's supposed to show.

definitions.name: I_ORAS_DOWSING_FLAG
definitions.upstream_comment: Replace 0 with an unused flag to enable the Dowsing Machine mechanic from ORAS.

definitions.name: I_ORAS_DOWSING_SOUNDS
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, the Dowsing Machine will make sounds based on how far away the hidden item is.

definitions.name: I_ORAS_DOWSING_COLOR_PAL
definitions.upstream_comment: The color within the palette that will change based on proximity to the item.

definitions.name: MPS_ENABLE_MAP_PREVIEWS
definitions.upstream_comment: Enables map previews.

definitions.name: MPS_DURATION_LONG
definitions.upstream_comment: This is the number of frames the map preview will last when the player enters the map for the first time.

definitions.name: MPS_DURATION_SHORT
definitions.upstream_comment: This is the number of frames the map preview will last if the player has visited the map before.

definitions.name: MPS_DURATION_NO_FLAG
definitions.upstream_comment: This is the number of frames the map preview will last if the map's flagId is MPS_FLAG_NULL.

definitions.name: MPS_BASIC_FADE_SPEED
definitions.upstream_comment: This sets the speed that the map preview fades to black when MPS_TYPE_BASIC is used.

definitions.name: OW_FLAG_SUPPRESS_NAME_BOX
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, any namebox (whether its from a macro or a code) will not show up until this flag is unset.

definitions.name: OW_NAME_BOX_USE_DYNAMIC_WIDTH
definitions.upstream_comment: When TRUE, the namebox window can use different width depending on the length of the speaker's name.

definitions.name: OW_NAME_BOX_NPC_TRAINER
definitions.upstream_comment: When TRUE, any approaching NPC trainers will have a namebox shown automagically. The name will be taken from their trainer data.

definitions.name: OW_NAME_BOX_DEFAULT_WIDTH
definitions.upstream_comment: Maximum width of what OW_NAME_BOX_USE_DYNAMIC_WIDTH can set. Also the default width when the config above is set to FALSE (or the dynamic width exceeds this value).

definitions.name: OW_NAME_BOX_DEFAULT_HEIGHT
definitions.upstream_comment: Maximum height of the namebox window.

definitions.name: OW_RUNNING_INDOORS
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, players are allowed to run indoors.

definitions.name: SLOW_MOVEMENT_ON_STAIRS
definitions.upstream_comment: If enabled, the player will move slower up/down stairs like in FR

definitions.name: OW_POISON_DAMAGE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4, Pokémon no longer faint from Poison in the overworld. In Gen5+, they no longer take damage at all.

definitions.name: OW_DOUBLE_APPROACH_WITH_ONE_MON
definitions.upstream_comment: If enabled, you can be spotted by two trainers at the same time even if you only have one eligible Pokémon in your party.

definitions.name: OW_HIDE_REPEAT_MAP_POPUP
definitions.upstream_comment: If enabled, map popups will not appear if entering a map with the same Map Section Id as the last.

definitions.name: OW_WHITEOUT_CUTSCENE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4+, whiting out shows an additional message and post whiteout event script cutscene with a healing NPC. (While this change was also in FRLG, for the sake of simplicity, setting this to GEN_3 will result in RSE behavior.)

definitions.name: OW_DEFOG_FIELD_MOVE
definitions.upstream_comment: If enabled, Defog can be used as a Field Move as seen in DPPt.

definitions.name: OW_ROCK_CLIMB_FIELD_MOVE
definitions.upstream_comment: If enabled, Rock Climb can be used as a Field Move as seen in DPPt.

definitions.name: OW_WHIRLPOOL_FIELD_MOVE
definitions.upstream_comment: If enabled, Whirlpool can be used as a Field Move as seen in GSC/HGSS.

definitions.name: OW_CHOOSE_FROM_PC_AND_PARTY
definitions.upstream_comment: If enabled, NPCs like move tutors or trainers asking for trade will let you pick a Pokémon from your PC or party instead of just your party

definitions.name: OW_ITEM_DESCRIPTIONS_OFF
definitions.upstream_comment: never show descriptions

definitions.name: OW_ITEM_DESCRIPTIONS_FIRST_TIME
definitions.upstream_comment: show first time (** SAVE-BREAKING - see struct SaveBlock3 **)

definitions.name: OW_ITEM_DESCRIPTIONS_ALWAYS
definitions.upstream_comment: always show description

definitions.name: OW_SHOW_ITEM_DESCRIPTIONS
definitions.upstream_comment: If enabled, item descriptions/images will be shown when finding items.

definitions.name: OW_PC_PRESS_B
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen4, pressing B when holding a Pokémon is equivalent to placing it. In Gen3, it gives the "You're holding a Pokémon!" error.

definitions.name: OW_PC_JAPAN_WALDA_ICONS
definitions.upstream_comment: In the US release of Emerald, the Cross, Bolt, and Plusle icons for Walda's wallpapers were left blank from the Japan release. Setting this to TRUE will restore them.

definitions.name: OW_PC_HEAL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, Pokémon are not healed when deposited in the PC.

definitions.name: OW_PC_MOVE_ORDER
definitions.upstream_comment: Starting in Gen4, the order of options in the PC menu change.

definitions.name: OW_PC_RELEASE_ITEM
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, Pokémon that get released with a held item return it to the bag.

definitions.name: OW_BERRY_MUTATIONS
definitions.upstream_comment: If enabled, Berry plants can mutate based on berries planted next to them.

definitions.name: OW_BERRY_MUTATION_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: Determines the % chance of a mutation.

definitions.name: OW_BERRY_MOISTURE
definitions.upstream_comment: If enabled, Berry watering is not a matter of watering it once per stage, but rather of keeping the soil moist.

definitions.name: OW_BERRY_ALWAYS_WATERABLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If OW_BERRY_MOISTURE is enabled, this setting allows the player to continuously water soil; dry soil will cause a decrease in Berry Yield (like Gen4). When off, soil can only be watered when dry and watering increases yield (like Gen6).

definitions.name: OW_BERRY_MULCH_USAGE
definitions.upstream_comment: If enabled, Mulch can be used on soil to fertilize it. Otherwise, it is considered unusable. Note that moisture effects only work with OW_BERRY_MOISTURE enabled!

definitions.name: OW_BERRY_WEEDS
definitions.upstream_comment: If enabled, weeds may grow on Berry plants that the player needs to take care of. Without OW_BERRY_MOISTURE, weeding bonuses are rounded down.

definitions.name: OW_BERRY_PESTS
definitions.upstream_comment: If enabled, pests may approach Berry plants that the player needs to take care of. Without OW_BERRY_MOISTURE, pest bonuses are rounded down.

definitions.name: OW_BERRY_SIX_STAGES
definitions.upstream_comment: In XY, Berries go through six stages instead of four. This toggle does not affect the time it takes for a tree to be ready for harvest. Without OW_BERRY_MOISTURE, the two extra stages count as BERRY_STAGE_TALLER for watering purposes.

definitions.name: OW_BERRY_GROWTH_RATE
definitions.upstream_comment: Presets for how long each Berry plant takes to grow.

definitions.name: OW_BERRY_YIELD_RATE
definitions.upstream_comment: Presets for how many Berries each plant can yield.

definitions.name: OW_BERRY_DRAIN_RATE
definitions.upstream_comment: If OW_BERRY_MOISTURE is enabled, this setting changes how fast the soil dries out. GEN_4 uses a Berry-dependent drain rate, GEN_6_XY dries out in 24 hours (4 hours with the relevant Mulch) and GEN_6_ORAS dries out in 4 hours. Other values are illegal.

definitions.name: OW_BERRY_IMMORTAL
definitions.upstream_comment: If enabled, once a Berry tree has grown a Berry, the tree will not disappear until picked by the player.

definitions.name: OW_BERRY_COLORS
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to GEN_6_XY or GEN_6_ORAS, the Chesto, Wiki, Bluk, Cornn, Pamtre, Belue, Ganlon, Watmel, Qualot, Spelon, Kasib, Colbur, Lansat, Kee, Payapa, Roseli, Liechi, Enigma, and Maranga will use their colors from the stated game. Other values are illegal.

definitions.name: OW_POKEMON_OBJECT_EVENTS
definitions.upstream_comment: Adds Object Event fields for every species. Can be used for NPCs using the OBJ_EVENT_GFX_SPECIES macro (eg. OBJ_EVENT_GFX_SPECIES(BULBASAUR))

definitions.name: OW_SUBSTITUTE_PLACEHOLDER
definitions.upstream_comment: Use a substitute OW for Pokémon that are missing overworld sprites

definitions.name: OW_LARGE_OW_SUPPORT
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, adds a small amount of overhead to OW code so that large (48x48, 64x64) OWs will display correctly under bridges, etc.

definitions.name: OW_PKMN_OBJECTS_SHARE_PALETTES
definitions.upstream_comment: [WIP!! NOT ALL PALETTES HAVE BEEN ADJUSTED FOR THIS!!] If TRUE, follower palettes are taken from battle sprites.

definitions.name: OW_GFX_COMPRESS
definitions.upstream_comment: Adds support for compressed OW graphics, (Also compresses Pokémon follower graphics).

definitions.name: OW_MON_WANDER_WALK
definitions.upstream_comment: If true, OW Pokémon with MOVEMENT_TYPE_WANDER will walk-in-place in between steps.

definitions.name: OW_FOLLOWERS_ENABLED
definitions.upstream_comment: Enables follower Pokémon, HGSS style. Requires OW_POKEMON_OBJECT_EVENTS. Note that additional scripting may be required for them to be fully supported!

definitions.name: OW_FOLLOWERS_BOBBING
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, follower Pokémon will bob up and down during their idle & walking animations

definitions.name: OW_FOLLOWERS_POKEBALLS
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, follower Pokémon will emerge from the Poké Ball they are stored in, instead of a normal Poké Ball

definitions.name: OW_FOLLOWERS_WEATHER_FORMS
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, Castform and Cherrim gain FORM_CHANGE_OVERWORLD_WEATHER, which will make them transform in the overworld based on the weather.

definitions.name: OW_FOLLOWERS_COPY_WILD_PKMN
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, follower Pokémon that know Transform or have Illusion/Imposter will copy wild Pokémon at random.

definitions.name: OW_BATTLE_ONLY_FORMS
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, loads overworld sprites for battle-only forms like Mega Evos. Requires OW_POKEMON_OBJECT_EVENTS.

definitions.name: B_FLAG_FOLLOWERS_DISABLED
definitions.upstream_comment: Enables / Disables followers by using a flag. Helpful to disable followers for a period of time.

definitions.name: OW_FOLLOWERS_SCRIPT_MOVEMENT
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, follower Pokémon only go back to their Poké Ball if a non-player collides with them by setting the FLAG_SAFE_FOLLOWER_MOVEMENT flag by default.

definitions.name: OW_SYNCHRONIZE_NATURE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, if a Pokémon with Synchronize leads the party, wild Pokémon will always have their same Nature as opposed to the 50% chance in previous games. Gift Pokémon excluded.

definitions.name: OW_SUPER_LUCK
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, if a Pokémon with Super Luck is leading the party, the wild held item rate is increased to 60%/20%.

definitions.name: OW_INFILTRATOR
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, if a Pokémon with Infiltrator is leading the party, the wild encounter rate is halved.

definitions.name: OW_HARVEST
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, if a Pokémon with Harvest is leading the party, there is a 50% chance to encounter a Grass-type Pokémon.

definitions.name: OW_LIGHTNING_ROD
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, if a Pokémon with Lightning Rod is leading the party, there is a 50% chance to encounter an Electric-type Pokémon.

definitions.name: OW_STORM_DRAIN
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, if a Pokémon with Storm Drain is leading the party, there is a 50% chance to encounter a Water-type Pokémon.

definitions.name: OW_FLASH_FIRE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen8+, if a Pokémon with Flash Fire is leading the party, there is a 50% chance to encounter a Fire-type Pokémon.

definitions.name: OW_TIMES_OF_DAY
definitions.upstream_comment: Different generations have the times of day change at different times.

definitions.name: OW_USE_FAKE_RTC
definitions.upstream_comment: When TRUE, seconds on the in-game clock will only advance once every 60 playTimeVBlanks (every 60 frames).

definitions.name: OW_ALTERED_TIME_RATIO
definitions.upstream_comment: In GEN_8_PLA, the time in game moves forward 60 seconds for every second in the RTC. In GEN_9, it is 20 seconds. TIME_DEBUG is 1:1, and meant for debugging purposes. This has no effect if OW_USE_FAKE_RTC is FALSE.

definitions.name: OW_TIME_OF_DAY_ENCOUNTERS
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, will allow the user to define and use different encounter tables based on the time of day.

definitions.name: OW_TIME_OF_DAY_DISABLE_FALLBACK
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, if the encounter table for a specific map and time is empty, the area will have no encounters instead of falling back to the vanilla map and time.

definitions.name: OW_TIME_OF_DAY_FALLBACK
definitions.upstream_comment: The time of day that encounter tables fall back to. If you set OW_TIMES_OF_DAY to GEN_3, change this to TIME_DAY or you won't have any encounters!

definitions.name: OW_SHADOW_INTENSITY
definitions.upstream_comment: Ranges from 0 to 16, where 0 is fully transparent and 16 is black.

definitions.name: OW_OBJECT_SUBPRIORITY
definitions.upstream_comment: The higher the value, the farther back compared to other sprites. Shadows should be behind object events.

definitions.name: OW_ENABLE_DNS
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, the overworld will be tinted depending on time of day.

definitions.name: OW_OBJECT_VANILLA_SHADOWS
definitions.upstream_comment: When FALSE, every object in the overworld has a shadow. WARNING: This means every object will take up two sprites instead of one. When TRUE, an object's shadow is only shown when jumping.

definitions.name: OW_FLAG_PAUSE_TIME
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set and OW_USE_FAKE_RTC is enabled, seconds on the in-game clock will not advance.

definitions.name: OW_FLAG_NO_TRAINER_SEE
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, trainers will not battle the player unless they're talked to.

definitions.name: OW_FLAG_NO_COLLISION
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, the player will be able to walk over tiles with collision. Mainly intended for debugging purposes.

definitions.name: OW_FLAG_POKE_RIDER
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, the player will be able to use fly from the Pokenav Region Map and the Town Map key item by pressing 'R' on a city/location they are able to fly to.

definitions.name: BATTLE_PYRAMID_RANDOM_ENCOUNTERS
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, battle pyramid Pokemon will be generated randomly based on the round's challenge instead of hardcoded in src/data/battle_frontier/battle_pyramid_level_50_wild_mons.h (or open_level_wild_mons.h)

definitions.name: OW_POPUP_GENERATION
definitions.upstream_comment: Different generations display location names in overworld pop-ups differently.

definitions.name: OW_POPUP_BW_TIME_NONE
definitions.upstream_comment: Don't show the time

definitions.name: OW_POPUP_BW_TIME_12_HR
definitions.upstream_comment: Use 12 hour (AM/PM) time

definitions.name: OW_POPUP_BW_TIME_24_HR
definitions.upstream_comment: Use 24 hour time

definitions.name: OW_POPUP_BW_COLOR_BLACK
definitions.upstream_comment: Black pop-up from B2

definitions.name: OW_POPUP_BW_COLOR_WHITE
definitions.upstream_comment: White pop-up from W2

definitions.name: OW_POPUP_BW_COLOR
definitions.upstream_comment: B2W2 use different colors for their map pop-ups.

definitions.name: OW_POPUP_BW_TIME_MODE
definitions.upstream_comment: Determines what type of time is shown.

definitions.name: OW_POPUP_BW_ALPHA_BLEND
definitions.upstream_comment: Enables alpha blending/transparency for the pop-ups. Mainly intended to be used with the black color option.

definitions.name: OW_IGNORE_EGGS_ON_HEAL
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen 4+, the nurse in the Pokémon Center does not heal Eggs on healing machine.

definitions.name: OW_UNION_DISABLE_CHECK
definitions.upstream_comment: When TRUE, the nurse does not inform the player if there is a trainer waiting in the Union Room. This speeds up the loading of the Pokémon Center.

definitions.name: OW_FLAG_MOVE_UNION_ROOM_CHECK
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, the game will only check if players are in the Union Room while healing Pokémon, and not when players enter the Pokémon Center. This speeds up the loading of the Pokémon Center. This is ignored if OW_UNION_DISABLE_CHECK is TRUE.

definitions.name: BERRY_BLENDER_THROW_ALL_BERRIES_AT_ONCE
definitions.upstream_comment: This is a small little addition, that basically speeds up the animation where all players' berries are thrown into the blender. Self-explanatory I hope!

definitions.name: OW_REMATCH_BADGE_COUNT
definitions.upstream_comment: Number of badges necessary before the match call or vs seeker features allow rematches

definitions.name: OW_AMBIENT_CRIES_NONE
definitions.upstream_comment: Do not play ambient cries.

definitions.name: OW_AMBIENT_CRIES_VANILLA
definitions.upstream_comment: Play ambient cries taken from encounter tables, as in vanilla.

definitions.name: OW_AMBIENT_CRIES_OWE_PRIORITY
definitions.upstream_comment: Play ambient cries based on active Overworld Wild Encounters, reverting to vanilla cries if none are present.

definitions.name: OW_AMBIENT_CRIES_OWE_ONLY
definitions.upstream_comment: Play ambient cries based on active Overworld Wild Encounters only.

definitions.name: OW_AMBIENT_CRIES
definitions.upstream_comment: Selects how ambient cries are played, if at all. As in vanilla, no matter what is chosen, cries will not play if the player is not on a map with Land or Water encounter tables.

definitions.name: OW_USE_DAILY_SEED_FOR_VANILLA_VARIABLES
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, use daily seed to compute mirage island chance and lottery corner tickets.

definitions.name: OW_CHECK_FOR_TOTAL_EVS
definitions.upstream_comment: If FALSE, givemon and createmon will not check for total EVs when generating a new Pokemon

definitions.name: POKEDEX_PLUS_HGSS
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, enables the custom HGSS style Pokedex.

definitions.name: HGSS_DECAPPED
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, uses decapped gfx and strings.

definitions.name: HGSS_DARK_MODE
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, enables dark mode.

definitions.name: HGSS_HIDE_UNSEEN_EVOLUTION_NAMES
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, hides evolution mon names.

definitions.name: HGSS_HIDE_UNOWNED_EVOLUTION_METHODS
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, hides evolution methods.

definitions.name: HGSS_SORT_TMS_BY_NUM
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, sorts the TMS in HGSS Dex by TM number, rather than alphabetically.

definitions.name: HGSS_SHOW_EGG_MOVES_FOR_EVOS
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, shows Egg Moves for evolved Pokémon too.

definitions.name: P_UPDATED_TYPES
definitions.upstream_comment: Some Pokémon have received type updates after their introduction.

definitions.name: P_UPDATED_STATS
definitions.upstream_comment: Some Pokémon have received base stat updates after their introduction.

definitions.name: P_UPDATED_ABILITIES
definitions.upstream_comment: Since Gen 4, certain Pokémon have had their abilities changed.

definitions.name: P_UPDATED_EGG_GROUPS
definitions.upstream_comment: Since Gen 8, certain Pokémon have gained new egg groups.

definitions.name: P_UPDATED_FRIENDSHIP
definitions.upstream_comment: Since Gen 8, the base friendship of certain Pokémon was changed.

definitions.name: P_UPDATED_EVS
definitions.upstream_comment: Since Gen 4, some Pokémon have received EV updates.

definitions.name: P_UPDATED_EXP_YIELDS
definitions.upstream_comment: Since Gen 5, some Pokémon have received base Experience changes.

definitions.name: P_LVL_UP_LEARNSETS
definitions.upstream_comment: Choose which set of Level Up Learnsets to use.

definitions.name: P_EVOLUTION_LEVEL_1_LEARN
definitions.upstream_comment: Since Gen 8, Pokémon evolving while at level 1 do not get the chance to learn their level 1 moves, while before they did.

definitions.name: P_FRIENDSHIP_EVO_THRESHOLD
definitions.upstream_comment: Since Gen 8, Pokémon that evolve by friendship evolve at or above 160 friendship instead of 220.

definitions.name: P_NIDORAN_M_DITTO_BREED
definitions.upstream_comment: Since Gen 5, when Nidoran♂ breeds with Ditto it can produce Nidoran♀ offspring. Before, it would only yield male offspring. This change also applies to Volbeat.

definitions.name: P_INCENSE_BREEDING
definitions.upstream_comment: Since Gen 9, cross-generation Baby Pokémon don't require Incense being held by the parents to be obtained via breeding.

definitions.name: P_EGG_HATCH_LEVEL
definitions.upstream_comment: Since Gen 4, Pokémon will hatch from Eggs at level 1 instead of 5.

definitions.name: P_BALL_INHERITANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: Since Gen 6, Eggs from the Day Care will inherit the Poké Ball from their mother. From Gen 7 onwards, the father can pass it down as well, as long as it's of the same species as the mother.

definitions.name: P_MOVE_INHERITANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: Prior to Gen 6, Eggs would inherit Egg moves from their father, TM moves from their father, level-up moves shared by both parents in that order. In Gen 6 and higher, Eggs would inherit level-up moves shared by both parents, Egg moves from their father, Egg moves from their mother in that order.

definitions.name: P_NATURE_INHERITANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen 3, Everstone grants Ditto and mothers a 50% chance to pass on Nature. Since Gen 4, anyone can pass on a Nature. Since Gen 5, the chance is 100%.

definitions.name: P_ABILITY_INHERITANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: In B2W2, a female Pokémon has an 80% chance of passing down their Ability if bred with a male. Since Gen 6, the chance is 80% for regular Ability and 60% for Hidden Ability, and anyone can pass down their Abilities if bred with Ditto. NOTE: BW's effect: 60% chance to pass down HA and random for regular Ability has been omitted.

definitions.name: P_EGG_MOVE_TRANSFER
definitions.upstream_comment: Starting in Gen 8, if two Pokémon of the same species are together in the Day Care, one knows an Egg Move, and the other has an empty slot, the other Pokémon will receive the Egg Move in the empty slot. In Gen 9, if a Pokémon holds a Mirror Herb, it will receive Egg Moves from the other regardless of species.

definitions.name: P_SCATTERBUG_LINE_FORM_BREED
definitions.upstream_comment: Choose the Scatterbug form all Vivillon/Spewpa/Scatterbug will breed into, basically aligning with the "location" of the player's game.

definitions.name: P_SHEDINJA_BALL
definitions.upstream_comment: Since Gen 4, Shedinja requires a Poké Ball for its evolution. In Gen 3, Shedinja inherits Nincada's Ball.

definitions.name: P_KADABRA_EVERSTONE
definitions.upstream_comment: Since Gen 4, Kadabra can evolve even when holding an Everstone.

definitions.name: P_SHUCKLE_BERRY_JUICE
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen 2, Shuckle had a 1/16 chance of converting Berry that it's holding into Berry Juice. Enabling this will allow Shuckle to do this with an Oran Berry, which is the spiritual succesor of the Berry item.

definitions.name: P_GENDER_DIFFERENCES
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, Pokémon will have graphical-only differences when they're female. Female *forms* such as Meowstic are not affected by this.

definitions.name: P_CUSTOM_GENDER_DIFF_ICONS
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, more Pokémon will have custom icons for their female differences, such as Hippopotas and Hippowdon.

definitions.name: P_ARCEUS_UNIQUE_FORM_ICONS
definitions.upstream_comment: Since Gen 9, Arceus changes its icon to reflect its current form.

definitions.name: P_FOOTPRINTS
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, Pokémon will have footprints (as was the case up to Gen 5 and in BDSP). Disabling this saves some ROM space.

definitions.name: P_TWO_FRAME_FRONT_SPRITES
definitions.upstream_comment: In Pokémon Emerald, Pokémon front sprites always consist of two frames. This config can revert it to only use the first frame, as is the case in the other Gen 3 games.

definitions.name: P_GBA_STYLE_SPECIES_GFX
definitions.upstream_comment: By default, Pokémon sprites use Gen 4/5's style. This config can revert them back to GBA-style. NOTE: B_ENEMY_MON_SHADOW_STYLE is disabled when using these sprites for now.

definitions.name: P_GBA_STYLE_SPECIES_ICONS
definitions.upstream_comment: By default, Pokémon have their updated icons. This config can revert them back to GBA-style.

definitions.name: P_GBA_STYLE_SPECIES_FOOTPRINTS
definitions.upstream_comment: By default, Pokémon have their updated footprints. This config can revert them back to GBA-style.

definitions.name: P_CRIES_ENABLED
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, Pokémon will have cries. Disabling this saves around a LOT of ROM space (over 25%!), but instead we recommend disabling individual unused Pokémon families in include/config/species_enabled.h.

definitions.name: P_LEGENDARY_PERFECT_IVS
definitions.upstream_comment: Since Gen 6, Legendaries, Mythicals and Ultra Beasts found in the wild or given through gifts have at least 3 perfect IVs.

definitions.name: P_EV_CAP
definitions.upstream_comment: Since Gen 6, the max EVs per stat is 252 instead of 255.

definitions.name: P_SHOW_TERA_TYPE
definitions.upstream_comment: Since Gen 9, the Tera Type is shown on the summary screen.

definitions.name: P_TM_LITERACY
definitions.upstream_comment: Since Gen 6, TM illiterate Pokémon can learn TMs that teach moves that are in their level-up learnsets.

definitions.name: P_CAN_FORGET_HIDDEN_MOVE
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, Pokémon can forget any move, even if it is an HM.

definitions.name: P_ASK_MOVE_CONFIRMATION
definitions.upstream_comment: If FALSE, when a player decides not to learn a move, the game does not ask the player for confirmation.

definitions.name: P_EGG_CYCLE_LENGTH
definitions.upstream_comment: Since Gen 8, Egg cycles take half as many steps as before. Previous generations have some varied step counts around 255.

definitions.name: P_ONLY_OBTAINABLE_SHINIES
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, Pokémon encountered in the Battle Pyramid or while catching is disabled won't be Shiny.

definitions.name: P_NO_SHINIES_WITHOUT_POKEBALLS
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, Pokémon encountered when the player is out of Poké Balls won't be Shiny.

definitions.name: P_SHOW_DYNAMIC_TYPES
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, all moves with dynamic type changes will be reflected as their current type in battle/summary screens instead of just select ones like in vanilla.

definitions.name: P_BASE_HP_1_SHEDINJA_HANDLING
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, all species with 1 Base HP will have their handling match Shedinja's.

definitions.name: P_LEARNSET_HELPER_TEACHABLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If FALSE, make sure to remove teachable_learnset.h from your .gitignore file. If TRUE, teachable_learnsets.h will be populated by tools/learnset_helpers/make_teachables.py using the included JSON files based on available TMs and tutors.

definitions.name: P_FLAG_FORCE_SHINY
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, all wild and gift Pokémon will forced into being Shiny.

definitions.name: P_FLAG_FORCE_NO_SHINY
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, all wild and gift Pokémon will forced into NOT being Shiny.

definitions.name: P_MODIFIED_MEGA_CRIES
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, will use the extra separate Mega Cries (approx. 3% space of ROM). if FALSE, will use the same cry for all Mega Evolutions except modified with P_MODIFIED_MEGA_CRY_MODE. By default, this is set based on if mega evolutions are enabled.

definitions.name: DONT_SKIP_GAPS
definitions.upstream_comment: Does not skip any gaps in the Pokédex.

definitions.name: SKIP_GAPS_EXCEPT_ONE
definitions.upstream_comment: Skips all gaps in the Pokédex other than one blank entry in between seen entries.

definitions.name: SKIP_GAPS_EXCEPT_BEFORE_AFTER
definitions.upstream_comment: Skips all gaps in the Pokédex other than one before and after seen entries. Most similar to whats seen in Pokémon SV.

definitions.name: SKIP_ALL_GAPS
definitions.upstream_comment: Skips all gaps in the Pokédex.

definitions.name: P_SKIP_POKEDEX_GAPS
definitions.upstream_comment: Pokémon SV skip large gaps in the Pokédex.

definitions.name: P_POKERUS_ENABLED
definitions.upstream_comment: If FALSE, Pokérus will have no effect, won't be shown and won't be aquired in any way but save data won't be affected

definitions.name: P_POKERUS_STRAIN_DISTRIBUTION
definitions.upstream_comment: Pokérus has 16 different strains and their probability distribution change depending on generation, GEN_3 will use the Ruby/Sapphire version and GEN_4 will use the version used in Emerald and Gen 4

definitions.name: P_POKERUS_SPREAD_ADJACENCY
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen 2, Pokérus spread to one adjacent Pokémon but it spreads to both adjacent Pokémon in gen 3+

definitions.name: P_POKERUS_SPREAD_DAYS_LEFT
definitions.upstream_comment: In Gen 2, a freshly spreaded Pokémon will get its full infection duration based on strain. In gen 3+, the Pokérus duration will copy the duration from the Pokémon it was spreaded from

definitions.name: P_POKERUS_INFECT_AGAIN
definitions.upstream_comment: If Gen 2 only, your party can get infected even when it is already infected with Pokérus (doesn't affect spreading)

definitions.name: P_POKERUS_VISIBLE_ON_EGG
definitions.upstream_comment: Controls if eggs can show Pokérus symbol in summary screen (TRUE from gen 3 to 6, FALSE in gen 2,7 and 8)

definitions.name: P_POKERUS_INFECT_EGG
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, eggs can receive Pokérus from spread and direction infection (gen 2). If FALSE, eggs can receive Pokérus from spread but not direct infection (gen 3). Behavior is unknown in other gens.

definitions.name: P_POKERUS_FLAG_INFECTION
definitions.upstream_comment: If Pokérus can only get infected if this flag is set or undefined (0). This emulates a gen 2 mechanic where Pokémon can only get infected by Pokérus after visiting Goldernrod. This does not affect spreading

definitions.name: P_POKERUS_HERD_IMMUNITY
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, Pokémon that have been previously infected by the Pokérus in your party reduce the chances of your party getting infected by the Pokérus (because they can be rolled at the target of the infection but are now "immune")

definitions.name: P_POKERUS_WEAK_VARIANT
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, the variant 0 of Pokérus can be erased by stronger variant when Pokérus is spreading

definitions.name: P_POKERUS_INFECTION_ODDS
definitions.upstream_comment: Actual probability is POKERUS_INFECTION_ODDS/65536

definitions.name: P_POKERUS_SPREAD_ODDS
definitions.upstream_comment: Actual probability is POKERUS_SPREAD_ODDS/65536 (21846 should correspond to the vanilla Random() % 3)

definitions.name: ENABLE_QUICKSTART
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE press SELECT to start a new game from the titlescreen (Disabled on Release Builds)

definitions.name: QUICKSTART_HUD
definitions.upstream_comment: Displays a small hud element on the titlescreen when Quickstart is enabled

definitions.name: QUICKSTART_HUD_X
definitions.upstream_comment: Quickstart HUD X Position

definitions.name: QUICKSTART_HUD_Y
definitions.upstream_comment: Quickstart HUD Y Position

definitions.name: SKIP_SAVE_CONFIRMATION
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, skips the "There is already a saved file" confirmation when overwriting a save.

definitions.name: FREE_EXTRA_SEEN_FLAGS_SAVEBLOCK1
definitions.upstream_comment: Free up unused Pokédex seen flags (52 bytes).

definitions.name: FREE_TRAINER_HILL
definitions.upstream_comment: Frees up Trainer Hill data (28 bytes).

definitions.name: FREE_TRAINER_TOWER
definitions.upstream_comment: Frees up Trainer Tower data (x bytes).

definitions.name: FREE_MYSTERY_EVENT_BUFFERS
definitions.upstream_comment: Frees up ramScript (1104 bytes).

definitions.name: FREE_MATCH_CALL
definitions.upstream_comment: Frees up match call and rematch / VS Seeker data. (104 bytes).

definitions.name: FREE_UNION_ROOM_CHAT
definitions.upstream_comment: Frees up union room chat (212 bytes).

definitions.name: FREE_ENIGMA_BERRY
definitions.upstream_comment: Frees up E-Reader Enigma Berry data (52 bytes).

definitions.name: FREE_LINK_BATTLE_RECORDS
definitions.upstream_comment: Frees up link battle record data (88 bytes).

definitions.name: FREE_MYSTERY_GIFT
definitions.upstream_comment: Frees up Mystery Gift data (876 bytes).

definitions.name: FREE_BATTLE_TOWER_E_READER
definitions.upstream_comment: Frees up Battle Tower E-Reader data (188 bytes).

definitions.name: FREE_POKEMON_JUMP
definitions.upstream_comment: Frees up Pokémon Jump data (16 bytes).

definitions.name: FREE_RECORD_MIXING_HALL_RECORDS
definitions.upstream_comment: Frees up hall records for record mixing (1032 bytes).

definitions.name: FREE_EXTRA_SEEN_FLAGS_SAVEBLOCK2
definitions.upstream_comment: Free up unused Pokédex seen flags (108 bytes).

definitions.name: P_SUMMARY_SCREEN_NATURE_COLORS
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, nature-based stat boosts and reductions will be red and blue in the summary screen.

definitions.name: P_SUMMARY_SCREEN_RENAME
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, an option to change Pokémon nicknames replaces the cancel prompt on the summary screen info page.

definitions.name: P_SUMMARY_SCREEN_IV_EV_INFO
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, will allow player to cycle through the Stats, IVs, and EVs in the summary screen skills page.

definitions.name: P_SUMMARY_SCREEN_IV_EV_BOX_ONLY
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, will allow player to cycle through the Stats, IVs, and EVs in the summary screen skills page, but only in the PC storage box.

definitions.name: P_SUMMARY_SCREEN_IV_HYPERTRAIN
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, stats that have been hyper trained will show as 31/S when viewing them in the summary screen

definitions.name: P_SUMMARY_SCREEN_IV_EV_TILESET
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, loads an alternate tileset to allow changing the "STATS" label in the summary screen skills page. Note: if it's still loading the alternate tileset after changing this and recompiling, you may need a `make clean` before compilation.

definitions.name: P_SUMMARY_SCREEN_IV_EV_VALUES
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, will show the actual IV value instead of the letter grade.

definitions.name: P_SUMMARY_SCREEN_IV_ONLY
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, will only show IV info in the summary screen.

definitions.name: P_SUMMARY_SCREEN_EV_ONLY
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, will only show EV info in the summary screen.

definitions.name: P_FLAG_SUMMARY_SCREEN_IV_EV_INFO
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, will allow player to cycle through the Stats, IVs, and EVs in the summary screen skills page. Note: if P_SUMMARY_SCREEN_IV_EV_INFO is TRUE, this flag does nothing.

definitions.name: P_ENABLE_MOVE_RELEARNERS
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, it enables move relearners for egg, TM and tutor. (see below for specific configs /flags)

definitions.name: P_SORT_MOVES
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, sorts all moves alphabetically in the relearner's list.

definitions.name: P_PRE_EVO_MOVES
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, it enables the Pokémon to learn moves from it's pre evolution.

definitions.name: P_ENABLE_ALL_LEVEL_UP_MOVES
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, it enables the Pokémon to learn all level up moves, regardless of its level.

definitions.name: P_TM_MOVES_RELEARNER
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, enables machine move relearner.

definitions.name: P_ENABLE_ALL_TM_MOVES
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, it enables the Pokémon to learn all TMs its compatible with, regardless of it being in the bag.

definitions.name: P_FLAG_EGG_MOVES
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, enables egg move relearner.

definitions.name: P_FLAG_TUTOR_MOVES
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, enables tutor move relearner.

definitions.name: P_SUMMARY_SCREEN_MOVE_RELEARNER
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, shows an option for Pokémon to relearn moves on the summary screen moves page.

definitions.name: P_SUMMARY_MOVE_RELEARNER_FULL_PP
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, the move relearner in the summary screen restores relearned moves' PP to full.

definitions.name: T_SHOULD_RUN_MOVE_ANIM
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, enables the move animation tests, these are very computationally heavy and takes a long time to run.

definitions.name: AUTO_SCROLL_TEXT
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, text will automatically scroll to the next line after NUM_FRAMES_AUTO_SCROLL_DELAY. Players can still press A_BUTTON or B_BUTTON to scroll on their own.

definitions.name: TEXT_SPEED_SLOW_MODIFIER
definitions.upstream_comment: How fast the SLOW text speed option prints

definitions.name: TEXT_SPEED_MEDIUM_MODIFIER
definitions.upstream_comment: How fast the MID text speed option prints

definitions.name: TEXT_SPEED_FAST_MODIFIER
definitions.upstream_comment: How fast the FAST text speed option prints

definitions.name: TEXT_SPEED_INSTANT_MODIFIER
definitions.upstream_comment: Needed only for the animation delays

definitions.name: TEXT_SPEED_INSTANT
definitions.upstream_comment: Renders all text as fast as it can, basically instant. Overrides FLAG_TEXT_SPEED_INSTANT and in-game player options menu setting.

definitions.name: FLAG_TEXT_SPEED_INSTANT
definitions.upstream_comment: Use this if you want to toggle instant text speed

definitions.name: WE_VANILLA_RANDOM
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, Pokémon can randomly spawn on tiles that can trigger wild encounters, as in vanilla.

definitions.name: WE_FLAG_NO_ENCOUNTER
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, wild encounters will be disabled.

definitions.name: WE_DOUBLE_WILD_CHANCE
definitions.upstream_comment: % chance of encountering two Pokémon in a Wild Encounter.

definitions.name: WE_DOUBLE_WILD_REQUIRE_2_MONS
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, Wild Double Battles will default to Single Battles when the player only has 1 usable Pokémon, ignoring WE_DOUBLE_WILD_CHANCE and WE_FLAG_FORCE_DOUBLE_WILD.

definitions.name: WE_WILD_NATURAL_ENEMIES
definitions.upstream_comment: If set to TRUE, certain wild mon species will attack other species when partnered in double wild battles (eg. Zangoose vs Seviper)

definitions.name: WE_FLAG_FORCE_DOUBLE_WILD
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, all land and surfing wild battles will be double battles.

definitions.name: WE_SMART_WILD_AI_FLAG
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, wild Pokémon will become smart, with all AI flags enabled.

definitions.name: WE_FLAG_NO_CATCHING
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, the ability to catch wild Pokémon is disabled.

definitions.name: WE_FLAG_NO_RUNNING
definitions.upstream_comment: If this flag is set, the ability to escape from wild battles is disabled. Also makes Roar/Whirlwind and Teleport (under Gen8) fail.

definitions.name: WE_OW_ENCOUNTERS
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, OW Pokémon can spawn as Overworld Wild Encounters on the current map. Requires OW_POKEMON_OBJECT_EVENTS.

definitions.name: WE_OWE_FLAG_DISABLED
definitions.upstream_comment: Replace 0 with a flag to use it to enable/disable generated OWEs.

definitions.name: WE_OWE_SPECIAL_ONLY
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, generated OWEs can only be special spawns.

definitions.name: WE_OWE_BATTLE_PIKE
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, OWEs can spawn in the Battle Pike, if FALSE random encounters will be enabled instead. Requires WE_OW_ENCOUNTERS to be TRUE.

definitions.name: WE_OWE_BATTLE_PYRAMID
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, OWEs can spawn in the Battle Pyramid, if FALSE random encounters will be enabled instead. Requires WE_OW_ENCOUNTERS to be TRUE.

definitions.name: WE_OWE_RESTRICT_METATILE
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, OWEs will stay within tiles with the same encounter metatile behavior as the one it is currently on, if any.

definitions.name: WE_OWE_RESTRICT_MAP
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, OWEs will stay within their current map bounds.

definitions.name: WE_OWE_UNRESTRICT_SIGHT
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, OWEs with movement behaviors that respond to the player, will ignore all movement restrictions when they can see the player.

definitions.name: WE_OWE_SPAWN_REPLACEMENT
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, the oldest OWE objects will despawn after a short time and be replaced with a new spawn if possible.

definitions.name: WE_OWE_FLEE_DESPAWN
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, a fleeing OWE will despawn if it is unable to take a step for a short time.

definitions.name: WE_OWE_SHINY_SPARKLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, shiny OWEs will spawn with a sparkle animation and play the shiny sound effect.

definitions.name: WE_OWE_FEEBAS_SPOTS
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, any spot that could result in a Feebas fishing encounter can spawn a Feebas OWE.

definitions.name: WE_OWE_DESPAWN_SOUND
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, plays SE_FLEE when an OWE despawns.

definitions.name: WE_OWE_APPROACH_FOR_BATTLE
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, OWEs will take steps to be right next to the player before the battle starts.

definitions.name: WE_OWE_PREVENT_SHINY_DESPAWN
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, shiny OWEs will not be despawned when off-screen if on the same map as the player, or be replaced if WE_OWE_SPAWN_REPLACEMENT is TRUE.

definitions.name: WE_OWE_PREVENT_FEEBAS_DESPAWN
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, Feebas OWEs spawned from special Feebas fishing spots (when WE_OWE_FEEBAS_SPOTS is TRUE) will not be despawned when off-screen if on the same map as the player, or be replaced if WE_OWE_SPAWN_REPLACEMENT is TRUE.

definitions.name: WE_OWE_PREVENT_SPECIAL_MOVEMENT_DESPAWN
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, shiny OWEs (if WE_OWE_PREVENT_SHINY_DESPAWN is TRUE) or Feebas OWEs (if WE_OWE_PREVENT_FEEBAS_DESPAWN is TRUE) will not be despawned by their movement type (for example, OWE_DESPAWN_ON_NOTICE).

definitions.name: WE_OWE_DESPAWN_ON_ENTER_TOWN
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, despawns all OWEs upon entering a city (MAP_TYPE_CITY) or town (MAP_TYPE_TOWN).

definitions.name: WE_OWE_NO_REPEL_DEXNAV_COLLISION
definitions.upstream_comment: If TRUE, OWEs cannot be triggered by a collision if a Repel or the DexNav is active.
